---
title: "Visualization of Genotyping Results"
subtitle: "`r paste0('Dataset: ', params$dataset_name, ' - ', params$n_barcodes, ' barcodes')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: kable
    highlight: tango
    theme:
      version: 5
      bg: "#FFFFFF"
      fg: "#2E2A26"
      primary: "#657359"
      secondary: "#8B775F"
      base_font: "Times New Roman"
      heading_font: "Times New Roman"
      headings-font-weight: 700
      code_font:
        google: "JetBrains Mono"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
params:
  # Dataset
  dataset_name: "big" # small or big
  n_barcodes: 24 # 6 for the small dataset, 24 for the big dataset

  # Shared input files, paths from the project folder
  primer_panel_path: "Data/Supporting_data/Primer_panels/12864_2021_7761_MOESM12_ESM_filtered.xlsx"
  reference_path: "Data/Supporting_data/Genome_reference_data/snps_500bp_sequences.fa"
  ngsfilter_path: "Data/Supporting_data/NGSfilter_file/ngsfilter.csv"

  # ASP run to plot, these are the same as the master pipeline of the current run (they also make up its results folder name)
  input_type: "unpadded" # "padded" or "unpadded"
  probe_type: "asp_primers" # "asp_primers" or "reference"
  use_anchors: true
  anchor_length: 3
  primer_quality: 19
  gap_opening: 6
  gap_extension: 2
  threshold_type: "errors" # "fraction" or "errors"
  min_score_fraction: 0.65 # "fraction" only
  error_rate: 0.08 # "errors" only
  min_errors: 1 # "errors" only
  min_snp_quality: 10
  max_mismatches: 2
  n_cores: 3

  # Genotype calling, shared with ASP and Minimap2 genotyping
  HT_min_frequence: 0.20 # minor allele must be larger or equal to call HT

  # Bayesian run to plot (same settings as Bayesian genotyping, the prior makes up its results folder name)
  prior_type: "ancestry" # "flat", "het_share" or "hwe"
  prior_het_share: 0.15 # only used when prior_type == "het_share"
  prior_population: "FreqWOLF_all" # only used when prior_type == hwe"
  prior_floor: 0.001 # only used when prior_type == "hwe"
  ancestry_prior_shape: 1 # only used when prior_type is "ancestry"
  phi_hom_structure: "shared" # "shared", "locus", "sample" or "locus_sample"

  # Which parts run: true = run, false = skip
  run_basic_plots: true # Basic visualization for ASP genotypes and Hierarchical bayes chunks, HWE and HMHT Heatmaps
  run_filtration_parameters: true # QD, Fisher strand, Amplicon rank, SNP quality and Minor allele fraction chunks
  run_speedopt_diagnosis: true # Scoring threshold simulation, Speed optimization, Du Bois and Problematic locus chunks
  run_filtration_vis: true # Demultiplexing and filtration process visualized chunk (Sankey, Upset, Barplot)
---

This script uses a lot of different chunks to visualize different genotyping results from different methods. Its really kinda long, before every chunk is a quick description of what im trying to show with the plots and some ideas and questions I was trying to answer with the visualization. Plots are saved inside Results/dataset_name/Graphics/...

After completing this script, move on to 07_Failed_Genotypes_Analysis.Rmd

## Settings, paths and basic setup
This chunks contain libraries, global settings, editable variables used by the whole .Rmd and paths for necessary input files.

```{r setup, results = "hide"}
suppressMessages({
  library(grid)
  library(Biostrings) # loaded firts because of shared functions names with dplyr
  library(pwalign)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(lme4)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(readxl)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(parallel)
  library(knitr)
})

# Settings come from the params block in the YAML header, this turns them into usable variables
invisible(list2env(params, envir = environment()))
settings_used <- data.frame(setting = c("run_date", names(params)),
                            value = c(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                      vapply(params, function(setting_value) paste(setting_value, collapse = ", "), character(1))))
# Uploading shared functions
source("Code/R_scripts/asp_functions.R", local = TRUE)

plot_font <- "Times New Roman"
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font))
hm_dark <- "#476F84"
hm_light <- "#A4BED5" #HM
ht_dark <- "#A4552A"
ht_light <- "#DDA77B" # HT
correct_colour <- "#72874E" # correct calls, reads used
error_colour <- "#d73027" # miscalls, incorrect calls, removing cutoffs
no_call_colour <- "grey70"
no_reference_colour <- "grey97"
fwd_colour <- "#B35806"
rv_colour <- "#542788" # forward and reverse reads
method_colours <- c(ASP = "#834D24", ASP_bayesian = "#834D24", minimap2 = "#E1C473")

# Paths for genotype and graphics outputs
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results", dataset_name, "Graphics") 
genotypes_dir <- file.path("Results", dataset_name, "Genotypes_results")

# Shared function for building accurate settings based folder names
run_names <- build_run_names(input_type, use_anchors, anchor_length, threshold_type, error_rate, min_score_fraction,
                             prior_type, prior_het_share, prior_population, prior_floor, probe_type = probe_type,
                             ancestry_prior_shape = ancestry_prior_shape, phi_hom_structure = phi_hom_structure)
asp_run_name <- run_names$asp_run_name
prior_label <- run_names$prior_label
bayes_run_name <- run_names$bayes_run_name

asp_path <- file.path(genotypes_dir, asp_run_name, "all_barcodes_asp_genotypes.tsv") # ASP Genotyper results and per read calls
asp_reads_path <- file.path(genotypes_dir, asp_run_name, "all_barcodes_asp_reads.tsv") 
mm2_path <- file.path(genotypes_dir, "MiniMap2_genotypes/all_barcodes_Minimap2_genotypes.tsv") # MiniMap2 genotype results
bayes_path <- file.path(genotypes_dir, bayes_run_name, "all_barcodes_base_mixture_genotypes_hierarchical.tsv") # ASP Hierarchical Bayes Genotyper results
ref_path <- file.path("Data/Supporting_data/Reference_genotypes", paste0("genotypes_", dataset_name, ".tsv")) # Genotype references

# Primer panel preparation with a shared function and the same scoring lookups for scoring threshold, problematic locus and Sankey plots
panel <- prepare_primer_panel(primer_panel_path, reference_path, input_type, use_anchors, anchor_length, probe_type = probe_type)
match_lookup <- build_match_lookup(primer_quality)
mismatch_cost_lookup <- vapply(0:93, function(q) mismatch_cost_f(q, primer_quality), numeric(1))

# Output paths for Identified, Bayes and MiniMap2 plots
out_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "ASP_Genotypes_Results_Plots")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
bayes_run_graphics_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "STAN_Hierarchical", run_names$bayes_settings_label) 
bayes_out_dir <- file.path(bayes_run_graphics_dir, "Basic_Results_Plots")
dir.create(bayes_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
mm2_out_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Minimap2_Genotypes_Results_Plots")
dir.create(mm2_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Imported shared data between all chunks, loaded and cleaned once in setup
asp_results <- read_tsv(asp_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
asp <- asp_results %>%
  transmute(sample = barcode, locus, genotype, method = "ASP")

bayes_raw <- read_tsv(bayes_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
bayes_asp <- bayes_raw %>%
  transmute(sample = barcode, locus, genotype, method = "ASP_bayesian", status)

mm2_raw <- read_tsv(mm2_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
mm2 <- mm2_raw %>%
  transmute(sample = barcode, locus, genotype, method = "minimap2")

ref <- read_tsv(ref_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(sample = sample_id, locus, genotype, method = "reference")
```



## Basic visualization for ASP genotypes results 
This chunk contains first visualizations for my ASP Genotypes results. It creates some basic plots, which are mostly visually useless, not that pretty and just get the basic points across. This plots are just results simply visualized, like concordance per locus and sample in comparison with MiniMap2 genotypes, some prettier violins plots for depth. It also creates a genotypes_comparison.tsv table.

```{r Basic_Visualization_for_ASP_Genotypes_results, eval = params$run_basic_plots, fig.width = 11.69, fig.height = 8.27, out.width = "100%"}
# Full data frame with all the genotypes
all_calls <- bind_rows(asp, mm2, ref)

# Comparison table sample and locus pairs per row and a match column per method
wide <- all_calls %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = genotype) %>%
  complete(sample, locus) %>% 
  mutate(asp_match = ASP == reference, # T or F, NA if one is missing
         mm2_match = minimap2 == reference,
         methods_agree = ASP == minimap2)

write.table(wide, file.path(out_dir, "full_comparison_table_identified.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# 1. Plot: Creates called genotypes heatmap per method
genotype_colours <- c(
  "AA" = "#593722",
  "CC" = "#2C5724",
  "GG" = "#476F84",
  "TT" = "#AB5D26",
  "AC" = "#A4B591",
  "AG" = "#E1C473",
  "AT" = "#D9A877",
  "CG" = "#A4BED5",
  "CT" = "#A8939E",
  "GT" = "#7F919B",
  "No call" = no_call_colour)

plot_data <- all_calls %>%
  mutate(genotype_display = ifelse(is.na(genotype), "No call", genotype))

p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sample, y = locus, fill = genotype_display)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~method, ncol = 3) + # Splits into 3 panels
  scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colours, name = "Genotype") + 
  labs(title = "Genotype calls by method", x = "Sample", y = "Locus") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "genotype_heatmap_by_method.png"), p1,
       width = 14, height = max(6, length(unique(plot_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "genotype_heatmap_by_method.pdf"), p1,
       width = 14, height = max(6, length(unique(plot_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), limitsize = FALSE, device = cairo_pdf)
print(p1)

# 2. Plot: Genotype match rate per sample
per_sample <- wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(reference)) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    ASP = mean(asp_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimap2 = mean(mm2_match, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ASP, minimap2), names_to = "method", values_to = "match_rate")

p2 <- ggplot(per_sample, aes(x = match_rate, y = reorder(sample, -match_rate), fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(match_rate < 1, percent(match_rate, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Match rate vs reference, per sample (worst at the top)", x = "Match rate", y = "Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "concordance_per_sample.png"), p2, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "concordance_per_sample.pdf"), p2, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, device = cairo_pdf)
print(p2)

# 3. Plot: Result concordance per locus
per_locus <- wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(reference)) %>%
  group_by(locus) %>%
  summarise(
    ASP = mean(asp_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimap2 = mean(mm2_match, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ASP, minimap2), names_to = "method", values_to = "match_rate")

# Average for both method, worst first
locus_avg <- per_locus %>% 
  group_by(locus) %>%
  summarise(avg_match = mean(match_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(avg_match)

p3 <- ggplot(per_locus, aes(x = match_rate, y = reorder(locus, -match_rate), fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(match_rate < 1, percent(match_rate, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Match rate vs reference, per locus (worst at the top)", x = "Match rate", y = "Locus") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "concordance_per_locus.png"), p3, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "concordance_per_locus.pdf"), p3, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, device = cairo_pdf)
print(p3)

# 4. Plot: Same as first heatmap just simpler with only red and green values for correct and incorrect called genotypes
match_data <- wide %>%
  select(sample, locus, reference, ASP = asp_match, minimap2 = mm2_match) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ASP, minimap2), names_to = "method", values_to = "is_match") %>%
  mutate(
    match_category = case_when(
      is.na(reference) ~ "No reference",
      is.na(is_match) ~ "No call",
      is_match ~ "Correct",
      TRUE ~ "Incorrect"))

p4 <- ggplot(match_data, aes(x = sample, y = locus, fill = match_category)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~method, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Correct" = correct_colour, "Incorrect" = error_colour,
               "No call" = no_call_colour, "No reference" = no_reference_colour),
    name = "Result") +
  labs(title = "Genotype calls vs reference truth", x = "Sample", y = "Locus") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "genotype_match_heatmap.png"), p4, width = max(9, length(unique(match_data$sample)) * 0.5 + 3),
       height = max(6, length(unique(match_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "genotype_match_heatmap.pdf"), p4, width = max(9, length(unique(match_data$sample)) * 0.5 + 3),
       height = max(6, length(unique(match_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), limitsize = FALSE, device = cairo_pdf)
print(p4)

# 5. Plot: Depth per locus and locus family in violin plots 
depth_family_pattern <- "^(BICF2P|BICF2S|BICF2G|TIGRP2P)"

# Creates locus families from the names prefix
depth_data <- asp_results %>%
  transmute(sample = barcode, locus, depth,
            locus_group = ifelse(grepl(depth_family_pattern, locus), sub(paste0(depth_family_pattern, ".*"), "\\1", locus), "Other"))

depth_fills <- c("all" = "#A4B591", "BICF2P" = "#AB5D26", "BICF2S" = "#E1C473", "BICF2G" = "#55804D", "TIGRP2P" = "#593722", "Other" = "grey70")

# One violin plot per row
depth_violin_f <- function(data, title, x_label, y_label) {
  medians <- data %>%
    group_by(row) %>%
    summarise(median_depth = median(depth, na.rm = TRUE), max_depth = max(depth, na.rm = TRUE))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = depth, y = row)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = fill_group), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", colour = "grey30", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(height = 0.12, width = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(data = medians, aes(x = median_depth, y = row), colour = "grey10", size = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = medians, aes(x = median_depth, xend = max_depth * 1.12, y = row, yend = row),
                 linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_label(data = medians, aes(x = max_depth * 1.15, y = row, label = sprintf("median = %.0f", median_depth)),
               hjust = 0, size = 2, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = depth_fills, name = "Locus\ngroup",
                      guide = if (n_distinct(data$fill_group) > 1) "legend" else "none") + # legend only when coloured by family
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.25))) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.9)) + # space between the rows
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_label, y = y_label)
}

# Depth per locus ordered by median depth, violin plots
depth_plot_locus <- depth_violin_f(depth_data %>% mutate(row = reorder(locus, depth, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE), fill_group = "all"), "Number of reads distribution per locus", "Reads per sample", "Locus")
print(depth_plot_locus)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_distribution_per_locus_violin.png"), depth_plot_locus, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_distribution_per_locus_violin.pdf"), depth_plot_locus, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, device = cairo_pdf)

# 6. Plot: Depth per sample ordered by median depth, violin plots
depth_plot_sample <- depth_violin_f(depth_data %>% mutate(row = reorder(sample, depth, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE), fill_group = "all"), "Number of reads distribution per sample", "Reads per locus", "Sample")
print(depth_plot_sample)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_distribution_per_sample_violin.png"), depth_plot_sample, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_distribution_per_sample_violin.pdf"), depth_plot_sample, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, device = cairo_pdf)

# 7. Plot: Depth per locus family ordered in groups by median depth, violin plots
depth_grouped_order <- depth_data %>%
  group_by(locus_group, locus) %>%
  summarise(median_depth = median(depth, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(locus_group, median_depth) %>%
  pull(locus)

depth_plot_grouped <- depth_violin_f(depth_data %>% mutate(row = factor(locus, levels = depth_grouped_order), fill_group = locus_group), "Read depth distribution per locus, grouped by locus family", "Reads per sample", "Locus")
print(depth_plot_grouped)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_depth_per_locus_grouped_violin.png"), depth_plot_grouped, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "read_depth_per_locus_grouped_violin.pdf"), depth_plot_grouped, width = 8.27, height = 11.69, device = cairo_pdf)
```



## Hierarchical bayes base mixture type 
This chunk contains the same first version of visualizations created for hierarchical Bayes model, same plots as the previous chunk just changed input paths and output paths for Bayes.

```{r Hierarchical_Bayes_Genotypes_Visualisation, eval = params$run_basic_plots, fig.width = 11.69, fig.height = 8.27, out.width = "100%"}
# Same chunks before it just uses Bayesian Genotypes results tables imported and cleaned in the setup chunk
bayes_all_calls <- bind_rows(select(bayes_asp, -status), mm2, ref)

# Comparison table sample and locus pairs per row and a match column per method
bayes_wide <- bayes_all_calls %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = genotype) %>%
  complete(sample, locus) %>% 
  mutate(asp_match = ASP_bayesian == reference, # T or F, NA if one is missing
         mm2_match = minimap2 == reference)

write.table(bayes_wide, file.path(bayes_out_dir, "full_comparison_table_bayesian_mixpooled.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# 1. Plot: Creates called genotypes heatmap per method
bayes_plot_data <- bayes_all_calls %>%
  mutate(genotype_display = ifelse(is.na(genotype), "No call", genotype))

p_bayes_genotypes <- ggplot(bayes_plot_data, aes(x = sample, y = locus, fill = genotype_display)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~method, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colours, name = "Genotype") +
  labs(title = "Genotype calls by method (pooled Bayesian mixture ASP)", x = "Sample", y = "Locus") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(bayes_out_dir, "genotype_heatmap_by_method_bayesian_mixpooled.png"), p_bayes_genotypes,
       width = max(14, length(unique(bayes_plot_data$sample)) * 0.5 + 4),
       height = max(6, length(unique(bayes_plot_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(bayes_out_dir, "genotype_heatmap_by_method_bayesian_mixpooled.pdf"), p_bayes_genotypes,
       width = max(14, length(unique(bayes_plot_data$sample)) * 0.5 + 4),
       height = max(6, length(unique(bayes_plot_data$locus)) * 0.15 + 2), limitsize = FALSE, device = cairo_pdf)
p_bayes_genotypes

# 2. Plot: Genotype match rate per sample
bayes_per_sample <- bayes_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(reference)) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    ASP_bayesian = mean(asp_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimap2 = mean(mm2_match, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ASP_bayesian, minimap2), names_to = "method", values_to = "match_rate")

p_bayes_per_sample <- ggplot(bayes_per_sample, aes(x = match_rate, y = reorder(sample, -match_rate), fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(match_rate < 1, percent(match_rate, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
```

## HWE Ternary Plots for ASP and Bayes Genotypes 
HWE Ternary plots showing posterior probabilities for Bayes genotypes and half a Ternary plot showing per locus points with reference comparison.

```{r HWE_Ternary_Plots_for_ASP_and_Bayes_Genotypes, eval = params$run_basic_plots, fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 10, out.width = "80%"}
# Uses data frames which were prepared in the setup chunk
hwe_ternary_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "HWE_Ternary_plots")
dir.create(hwe_ternary_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Skips loci with too few called samples (safety check with smaller datasets)
min_samples_per_locus <- 4
hwe_methods <- c("reference", "ASP", "ASP_bayesian")

# Deviation from HWE was tested with the exact test (Wigginton et al., 2005), p value is the sum of all outcomes that are as likely or less likely than the observed one. This function takes a number of HT majors and minors and number of HT for one specific locus across all samples and it checks wether these countswould look like randommating (is in HW equilibrium) or not (other factors).
hwe_exact_p <- function(n_hom_major, n_het, n_hom_minor) {
  n <- n_hom_major + n_het + n_hom_minor # Calculates number of samples
  n_minor <- 2 * min(n_hom_major, n_hom_minor) + n_het # Calculates number of minor alleles
  het_possible <- seq(n_minor %% 2, n_minor, by = 2) # Exact test asks keeps the minor alleles and asks in how many different ways could they split into genotypes
  log_prob <- vapply(het_possible, function(het) { # Vapply takes each possible HT split and applies it to the function. This gives the probability of getting each split if alleles were mixed randomly (HWE)
    hom_minor <- (n_minor - het) / 2 # Calculates other HM minor and major based on the number of HT split
    hom_major <- n - het - hom_minor
    # Probability calculations turned into log for ease of. use with "+" and "-" ("P(counts|allele counts) = n!/(n_AA!*n_AB!*n_BB!)*2^n_AB*n_A!*n_B!/(2n)!")
    lfactorial(n) - lfactorial(hom_major) - lfactorial(het) - lfactorial(hom_minor) + het * log(2) + 
      lfactorial(n_minor) + lfactorial(2 * n - n_minor) - lfactorial(2 * n)
  }, numeric(1))
  prob <- exp(log_prob) # Turned back to normal probability
  observed_prob <- prob[het_possible == n_het] # Takes the probability of that split if the popualtion were in HWE
  min(1, sum(prob[prob <= observed_prob * (1 + 1e-7)])) # p-value is the sum of all splits probabilites which are even less likely or as likely
}

# All called genotypes fo the three methods, filtered for loci with enough samples
hwe_calls <- bind_rows(ref, asp, select(bayes_asp, -status)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genotype)) %>%
  group_by(method, locus) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_samples_per_locus) %>%
  ungroup()

# Counts allele copies per method and locus
hwe_allele_counts <- hwe_calls %>%
  mutate(allele_1 = substr(genotype, 1, 1), allele_2 = substr(genotype, 2, 2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(allele_1, allele_2), values_to = "allele") %>%
  count(method, locus, allele)

# Loci with moren than 2 different alleles are erros, they are left out in further analysis
hwe_too_many_alleles <- hwe_allele_counts %>% count(method, locus, name = "n_alleles") %>% filter(n_alleles > 2)
if (nrow(hwe_too_many_alleles) > 0) print(hwe_too_many_alleles)

# Major and minor alleles per method and locus
hwe_alleles <- hwe_allele_counts %>%
  group_by(method, locus) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), allele, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
  summarise(major = allele[1], minor = allele[2], .groups = "drop")

#Genotype counts per method and locus and applied exact test with HWE statistics
hwe_counts <- hwe_calls %>%
  inner_join(hwe_alleles, by = c("method", "locus")) %>% 
  group_by(method, locus) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_hom_major = sum(genotype == paste0(major, major)),
            n_het = sum(genotype %in% c(paste0(major, minor), paste0(minor, major))),
            n_hom_minor = sum(genotype == paste0(minor, minor)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(locus) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(method) == length(hwe_methods)) %>% # Filter for same loci across methods so its comparable
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(major_freq = (2 * n_hom_major + n_het) / (2 * n),
         he = 2 * major_freq * (1 - major_freq), # HWE expected HT
         ho = n_het / n, # HT observed
         f = 1 - ho / he, # Inbreeding coeeficient, if its > 0 to few HT, < 0 too many HT
         hwe_p = mapply(hwe_exact_p, n_hom_major, n_het, n_hom_minor), # Applies previously defined exact test function
         hwe_result = case_when(hwe_p >= 0.05 ~ "In HWE",
                                ho < he ~ "Heterozygote deficit (p < 0.05)",
                                TRUE ~ "Heterozygote excess (p < 0.05)"),
         method = factor(method, levels = hwe_methods))

# 1. Plot: Genotype posterior ternary plot for Bayes only
ternary_called <- filter(bayes_raw, status == "called")
ternary_confidence <- cut(ternary_called$max_posterior, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.80, 0.95, Inf), right = FALSE, 
                          labels = c("uncertain (<0.80)", "intermediate (0.80-0.95)", "high (>=0.95)"))
ternary_colours <- c("uncertain (<0.80)" = error_colour, "intermediate (0.80-0.95)" = "#D9B44A", "high (>=0.95)" = correct_colour)

# Calcualates positions for each locus in the triangle (HT at the top, HM1 at x = 0 y = 0, and HM2 at x = 1, y = 0)
tern_x <- function(ab, bb) bb + ab / 2 # MAF
tern_y <- function(ab) ab * sqrt(3) / 2

# Grid lines at 25, 50 and 75 % of each genotype
ternary_shares <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
ternary_grid <- bind_rows(
  tibble(x = tern_x(ternary_shares, 0), y = tern_y(ternary_shares), xend = tern_x(ternary_shares, 1 - ternary_shares), yend = tern_y(ternary_shares)), # HT share
  tibble(x = tern_x(0, ternary_shares), y = 0, xend = tern_x(1 - ternary_shares, ternary_shares), yend = tern_y(1 - ternary_shares)), # HM2 share
  tibble(x = tern_x(0, 1 - ternary_shares), y = 0, xend = tern_x(1 - ternary_shares, 0), yend = tern_y(1 - ternary_shares))) # HM1 share

p_ternary_posterior <- ggplot(mutate(ternary_called, confidence = ternary_confidence),
                              aes(x = tern_x(posterior_het, posterior_hom2), y = tern_y(posterior_het), colour = confidence)) +
  geom_segment(data = ternary_grid, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), colour = "grey90", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("polygon", x = c(0, 1, 0.5), y = c(0, 0, sqrt(3) / 2), fill = NA, colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = c(0, 1, 0.5), y = c(-0.04, -0.04, sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.04), label = c("hom1", "hom2", "het")) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ternary_colours, breaks = rev(names(ternary_colours)), name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-0.08, 1.08), ylim = c(-0.08, 0.95), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = sprintf("Genotype posterior ternary plot - hierarchical base mixture (n=%d)", nrow(ternary_called))) +
  theme_void(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

#print(p_ternary_posterior)
#ggsave(file.path(hwe_ternary_dir, "ternary_posterior_bayesian.png"), p_ternary_posterior, width = 7, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
#ggsave(file.path(hwe_ternary_dir, "ternary_posterior_bayesian.pdf"), p_ternary_posterior, width = 7, height = 6.5, device = cairo_pdf)

# 2. Plot: HWE ternary plot by locus, each observed locus moves away from its reference genotypes, the difference is presented with arrows. MAF is along the base, AA is awlays the major one, so only half the traingle is needed

tern_n <- median(hwe_counts$n) # typical number of called samples per locus
tern_n_loci <- n_distinct(hwe_counts$locus)

#small tibble for each curve described by F (inbreeding coeficcient)
tern_edges <- tibble(edge = c("hwe", "nominal_low", "nominal_high", "bonferroni_low", "bonferroni_high"), # chi-square HWE test accepts |F| below the limit
                     f = c(0, 1, -1, 1, -1) * sqrt(qchisq(1 - 0.05 / c(1, 1, 1, tern_n_loci, tern_n_loci), df = 1) / tern_n))

tern_curves <- expand_grid(p = seq(0.5, 1, by = 0.001), tern_edges) %>% 
  mutate(ab = 2 * p * (1 - p) * (1 - f),
         aa = p - ab / 2,
         bb = 1 - p - ab / 2) %>%
  filter(aa >= 0, bb >= 0) %>%
  mutate(x = tern_x(ab, bb), y = tern_y(ab))
tern_band <- bind_rows(filter(tern_curves, edge == "nominal_high") %>% arrange(p), # 95 % band polygon
                       filter(tern_curves, edge == "nominal_low") %>% arrange(desc(p)))

# Left half of the triangle
tern_half <- tibble(x = c(0, 0.5, 0.5), y = c(0, 0, sqrt(3) / 2))

# Lines for equal HT share
tern_het_lines <- tibble(het = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) %>%
  mutate(x = het / 2, y = tern_y(het))
tern_maf_ticks <- tibble(x = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.1))


tern_curve_labels <- tern_edges %>% 
  filter(edge %in% c("hwe", "nominal_high", "bonferroni_high")) %>%
  mutate(x = 0.46, # MAF where the arrows point, just inside the right side
         y = tern_y(2 * 0.54 * 0.46 * (1 - f)), 
         label = c("Hardy-Weinberg\nequilibrium",
                   sprintf("95%% acceptance band\n(chi-square, %d samples)", tern_n),
                   sprintf("Bonferroni band\n(%d loci)", tern_n_loci)),
         label_y = y + c(0.08, 0.02, 0.06)) # labels sit a little above their curve

hw_ternary_plot <- function(method_name, display_name) { # short names used in title and legend
  tern_points <- hwe_counts %>%
    filter(method %in% c("reference", method_name)) %>%
    mutate(x = tern_x(n_het / n, n_hom_minor / n), y = tern_y(n_het / n))
  
  # one row per locus for reference and called position
  tern_moves <- tern_points %>% 
    transmute(locus, source = ifelse(method == "reference", "ref", "called"), x, y) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = c(x, y)) %>%
    mutate(length = sqrt((x_called - x_ref)^2 + (y_called - y_ref)^2),
           gap = 0.01 / length) %>% # small gap for arrows
    filter(length > 0.025) %>% 
    mutate(x_start = x_ref + (x_called - x_ref) * gap, y_start = y_ref + (y_called - y_ref) * gap,
           x_end = x_called - (x_called - x_ref) * gap, y_end = y_called - (y_called - y_ref) * gap)
  
  tern_failed <- sum(tern_points$method == method_name & tern_points$hwe_result != "In HWE")
  
  tern_labels <- c("In HWE" = sprintf("%s genotypes in HWE", display_name),
                   "Heterozygote deficit (p < 0.05)" = sprintf("%s genotypes, HT deficit (p < 0.05)", display_name),
                   "Heterozygote excess (p < 0.05)" = sprintf("%s genotypes, HT excess (p < 0.05)", display_name))
  
  tern_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = tern_band, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "grey90") +
    geom_path(data = filter(tern_curves, startsWith(edge, "bonferroni")), aes(x = x, y = y, group = edge), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_segment(data = tern_het_lines, aes(x = x, xend = 0.5, y = y, yend = y), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = tern_het_lines, aes(x = 0.51, y = y, label = sprintf("%.0f%% het", het * 100)), hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_polygon(data = tern_half, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_path(data = filter(tern_curves, edge == "hwe"), aes(x = x, y = y), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey25") +
    geom_segment(data = tern_curve_labels, aes(x = 0.575, y = label_y, xend = x, yend = y), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.3, "mm"), type = "closed")) + 
    geom_text(data = tern_curve_labels, aes(x = 0.58, y = label_y, label = label), hjust = 0, size = 2.9, colour = "grey25", lineheight = 0.95) +
    geom_segment(data = tern_moves, aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end, linetype = "shift"), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.6, "mm"), type = "closed"), key_glyph = "path") +
    geom_point(data = filter(tern_points, method == "reference"), aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "reference"), fill = "white", colour = "grey35", size = 2.2) +
    geom_point(data = filter(tern_points, method == method_name), aes(x = x, y = y, colour = hwe_result), size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.82, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.6, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 1.1, colour = "grey15",
             label = sprintf("Genotype frequencies per locus\nvs Hardy-Weinberg\nreference -> %s", display_name)) + 
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.70, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.1, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 1.2, colour = "grey15",
             label = sprintf("%d of %d loci fail the exact HWE test\n(%.1f expected by chance).", tern_failed, tern_n_loci, 0.05 * tern_n_loci)) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.63, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.1, lineheight = 1.2, colour = "grey15",
             label = "Each point is one locus, placed by\nthe share of its samples called\nAA (major homozygote),\nAB (heterozygote) and\nBB (minor homozygote).\n\nBelow the band =\ntoo few heterozygotes.") +
    geom_segment(data = tern_maf_ticks, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0, yend = -0.012), colour = "grey40") + # MAF axis
    geom_text(data = tern_maf_ticks, aes(x = x, y = -0.035, label = x), size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = -0.08, label = "Minor allele frequency", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = -0.015, y = 0, label = "AA", hjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.03, label = "AB", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("In HWE" = "grey30", "Heterozygote deficit (p < 0.05)" = hm_dark, "Heterozygote excess (p < 0.05)" = ht_dark),
                        labels = tern_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(reference = 21), labels = c(reference = "Reference"), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(shift = "solid"), labels = c(shift = "Shift from reference"), name = NULL) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1), linetype = guide_legend(order = 2), colour = guide_legend(order = 3, nrow = 1)) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-0.1, 0.75), ylim = c(-0.09, 0.9), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal", legend.spacing.x = unit(12, "pt"),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20))
  
  ggsave(file.path(hwe_ternary_dir, sprintf("hw_ternary_by_locus_%s.png", method_name)), tern_plot, width = 9.5, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(hwe_ternary_dir, sprintf("hw_ternary_by_locus_%s.pdf", method_name)), tern_plot, width = 9.5, height = 10, device = cairo_pdf)
  tern_plot
}

p_tern_asp <- hw_ternary_plot("ASP", "ASP")
p_tern_bayesian <- hw_ternary_plot("ASP_bayesian", "Bayes")
print(p_tern_asp)
print(p_tern_bayesian)
```



## Depth and HM/HT heatmap 
This chunk holds a function for two types of heatmaps, one for depth and one for zygosity. It calls it for both Bayes and ASP genotyper and saves plots  automatically into seperate folders. 
Heatmaps shows all the called genotypes by HM and HT pairs, call with no reference (black outline), wrongly called genotypes (black crosses) and no calls caused by low depth. Note: low depth is set in the master pipeline, for plots created at the moment its set way too low at minimum depth of 3. This should be changed for final results, which would in turn also bring the accuracy of the genotyper closer to 100 %. 

```{r Depth_and_HMHT_Heatmap, eval = params$run_basic_plots, fig.width = 11.69, fig.height = 8.27, out.width = "100%"}

make_genotype_plot <- function(asp_df, method_label, ref, out_path, plot_title, type = c("zygosity", "depth"), panel_title = method_label) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
# Read totals order from top to bottom (highest to lowest depth locus) and left to right (highest to lowest depth sample), data preparation
  locus_totals <- asp_df %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    summarise(total_reads = sum(depth, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_reads))

  sample_totals <- asp_df %>%
    group_by(sample) %>%
    summarise(total_reads = sum(depth, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_reads))

  sample_order <- sample_totals$sample
  locus_levels <- rev(locus_totals$locus)

# one row per sample locus pair, calls without a reference keep the value but they are marked with a black outline as no reference calls, pairs which did not produce a call are grey
  method_tiles <- asp_df %>%
    left_join(select(ref, sample, locus, reference = genotype), by = c("sample", "locus"), relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    mutate(zygosity = case_when(is.na(reference) & is.na(genotype) ~ "No reference",
                                is.na(genotype) ~ "No call",
                                substr(genotype, 1, 1) == substr(genotype, 2, 2) ~ "Homozygous",
                                TRUE ~ "Heterozygous"),
           zygosity = factor(zygosity, levels = c("Homozygous", "Heterozygous", "No call", "No reference")),
           no_reference_call = is.na(reference) & !is.na(genotype),
           locus = factor(locus, levels = locus_levels),
           sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order))
  
  no_reference_cells <- filter(method_tiles, no_reference_call) # calls with no reference
  scored_tiles <- filter(method_tiles, !is.na(reference), !is.na(genotype)) # calls with reference

# Plot subtitle preparation, show number of called pairs, number of misscalled pairs and accuracy
  miscall_subtitle <- scored_tiles %>%
    mutate(reference_zygosity = ifelse(substr(reference, 1, 1) == substr(reference, 2, 2), "homozygous", "heterozygous")) %>%
    count(reference_zygosity, miscalled = genotype != reference) %>%
    filter(miscalled) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("%d miscalled %s genotype%s", n, reference_zygosity, ifelse(n == 1, "", "s"))) %>%
    pull(label) %>%
    paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  if (miscall_subtitle == "") miscall_subtitle <- "no miscalled genotypes"
  n_called_with_ref <- nrow(scored_tiles)
  n_correct <- sum(scored_tiles$genotype == scored_tiles$reference)
  accuracy_subtitle <- if (n_called_with_ref == 0) {sprintf("no %s/reference overlap to score", method_label)} else {
    sprintf("%d/%d calls correct (%.1f%% accuracy)", n_correct, n_called_with_ref, 100 * n_correct / n_called_with_ref)
  }

# Call rate over all sample locus pairs, including those without a reference
  n_pairs_total <- length(sample_order) * length(locus_levels)
  n_called_total <- sum(!is.na(method_tiles$genotype))
  call_rate_subtitle <- sprintf("Call rate: %d/%d (%.1f%%)", n_called_total, n_pairs_total, 100 * n_called_total / n_pairs_total)

# Saves pairs with wrong calls
  mismatch_cells <- filter(scored_tiles, genotype != reference)

  heatmap_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5), 
          panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(t = -10, r = 2, b = 4, l = 4),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), 
          legend.key.size = unit(14, "pt"), 
          legend.key.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"), 
          legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

# black outlines for calls with no reference are drawn a little bit inside the tile so it doesnt touch other cells
no_reference_outline <- geom_tile(data = no_reference_cells, aes(x = sample, y = locus), fill = NA, colour = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.9, height = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE)

# Because the extra markers are not mapped in aes() they need an extra step for legend. Custom legend entries for the two extra markers, creates marker labels and marker key which creates two entries for legend (shape is mapped to marker with alpha = 0 which makes it transparent)
  marker_labels <- c(sprintf("Called, no reference (%d)", nrow(no_reference_cells)),
                     sprintf("Incorrect call (%d)", nrow(mismatch_cells)))
  
# Two placeholder rows (one per legend entry) on an existing tile used to create a legend
  marker_key <- data.frame(sample = factor(sample_order[1], levels = sample_order),
                           locus = factor(locus_levels[length(locus_levels)], levels = locus_levels),
                           marker = factor(marker_labels, levels = marker_labels))
  
# This makes the two figures for two legend entries, one box split diagonally into both colours and one with black outline or X on top
  make_draw_key_marks <- function(fill_low, fill_high) {
    function(data, params, size) { # polygonGrob hold instructions for building a graphical object
      split_tile <- list(polygonGrob(x = c(0, 1, 0), y = c(0, 0, 1), gp = gpar(fill = fill_low, col = NA)), # two triangles for legend
                         polygonGrob(x = c(1, 1, 0), y = c(0, 1, 1), gp = gpar(fill = fill_high, col = NA)))
      mark <- if (data$shape == 0) { # rectGrob makes a rectangle
        rectGrob(width = 1, height = 1, gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 1.3)) # gpar set the look of graphical objects - black outline
      } else { # pointsGrob makes points symbols
        pointsGrob(0.5, 0.5, pch = 4, gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, cex = 0.9)) # X marker on the heatmap
      }
      do.call(grobTree, c(split_tile, list(mark))) # This groups several "grobs" (graphical objects) together, one on top of the other
    }
  }
  
# geom_point() plots those marker_key entries with shape mapped to marker
  make_marker_legend <- function(fill_low, fill_high) list(
    geom_point(data = marker_key, aes(x = sample, y = locus, shape = marker), alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE, # transparent points
               key_glyph = make_draw_key_marks(fill_low, fill_high)),
    scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(0, 4), marker_labels), name = NULL), #
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                                theme = theme(legend.title = element_blank()))))

# Based on input type it creates a different plot, here the heatmaps actually differ
  if (type == "zygosity") {
    zygosity_fills <- c("Homozygous" = hm_dark, "Heterozygous" = ht_dark, "No call" = no_call_colour, "No reference" = no_reference_colour)

    # Legend labels with numbers of tiles showing results clearly
    zygosity_counts <- table(method_tiles$zygosity) # Counts all four factors of zygosity
    zygosity_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(zygosity_counts), as.integer(zygosity_counts)), names(zygosity_counts))

    # Heatmap for zygosity
    panels <- ggplot(method_tiles, aes(x = sample, y = locus, fill = zygosity)) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
      no_reference_outline +
      geom_point(data = mismatch_cells, aes(x = sample, y = locus, colour = zygosity),
                 shape = 4, size = 2.5, stroke = 1.3, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = zygosity_fills, labels = zygosity_labels, name = "LEGEND", drop = FALSE) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("Homozygous" = "white", "Heterozygous" = "white"), guide = "none") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3), order = 1, byrow = TRUE)) + # grey border for "No reference"
      make_marker_legend(zygosity_fills[["Homozygous"]], zygosity_fills[["Heterozygous"]]) +
      labs(title = panel_title, x = "Sample", y = "Locus") +
      heatmap_theme +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))

    combined_layout <- plot_layout(guides = "collect") # Legend on the right side, using patchwork for consistency with the depth heatmap
  } else {

# 2.Plot: Depth heatmap with sample depth on top and locus depth on the right side (ordered)
    # Only two axis marks so one in the middle and one for max value
    orientation_breaks <- function(totals) signif(c(max(totals) / 2, max(totals)), 2)
    reads_axis_labels <- label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k", accuracy = 1)

    # First panel for sample depth
    p_sample_reads <- ggplot(sample_totals %>% 
                            mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order)), aes(x = sample, y = total_reads)) +
      geom_col(fill = "grey50", width = 0.8) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = orientation_breaks(sample_totals$total_reads), labels = reads_axis_labels,
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
      theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
      labs(y = "Reads", title = panel_title)

    # Second panel for locus depth
    p_locus_reads <- ggplot(locus_totals %>% 
                              mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = locus_levels)), aes(x = total_reads, y = locus)) +
      geom_col(fill = "grey50", width = 0.8) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = orientation_breaks(locus_totals$total_reads), labels = reads_axis_labels,
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
      theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 8) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
      labs(x = "Reads")

    # Main panel showing depth heatmap
    p_main <- ggplot(method_tiles, aes(x = sample, y = locus)) +
      geom_tile(data = filter(method_tiles, !is.na(genotype)), aes(fill = depth), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
      geom_tile(data = filter(method_tiles, zygosity == "No call"), fill = no_call_colour, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
      geom_tile(data = filter(method_tiles, zygosity == "No reference"), fill = no_reference_colour, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
      no_reference_outline +
      geom_point(data = mismatch_cells, aes(x = sample, y = locus), shape = 4, size = 2, stroke = 1.3, colour = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      make_marker_legend("#A4B591", "#A4B591") + 
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F1E4DB", high = "#2C5724", transform = "log1p", name = "Depth (reads)", # log because it goes from 3 to 3000
                          breaks = c(3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, 3000), labels = label_comma(),
                          guide = guide_colourbar(order = 1)) +
      labs(x = "Sample", y = "Locus") +
      heatmap_theme

    # Plot is split into 11 column, 9 for heatmap, 1 for locus reads  and one for legends and 10 rows 1 for sample reads and 9 for heatmap
    layout <- c(area(t = 1, l = 1, b = 1, r = 9),
                area(t = 2, l = 1, b = 10, r = 9),
                area(t = 2, l = 10, b = 10, r = 10),
                area(t = 2, l = 11, b = 10, r = 12)) 
    panels <- p_sample_reads + p_main + p_locus_reads + guide_area()
    combined_layout <- plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect")}

 # Combines the panels and layout and saves the plots
  p_combined <- panels +
    combined_layout +
    plot_annotation(title = plot_title, # Annotation and legend theme for the whole plot not separate panels
                            subtitle = sprintf("%s | %s vs reference: %s | %s", call_rate_subtitle, method_label, miscall_subtitle, accuracy_subtitle),
                            theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), 
                                             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                                             legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
                                             legend.justification = c(0, 0.5), 
                                             legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, -10)))

  # saving in landscape both plots
  ggsave(out_path, p_combined, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, dpi = 300, bg = "white") 
  ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", out_path), p_combined, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, device = cairo_pdf)

  p_combined 
}

### Function calling

identified_genotypes <- transmute(asp_results, sample = barcode, locus, genotype, depth) # ASP calls with their read depth
```

## QD parameter threshold analysis and visualization 
With chunk i trz to figure out if QD could serve as a form of a secondary filter for separating miscalls from correctly genotyped pairs based on quality score margins. I got this idea from GATKs QD, its build from ASP alignment scores. After every read is aligned to ASP1 and ASP2 primers score margin can be computed (which is essentially Q score of the SNP). Higher quality SNP give larger margin nad vice versa. Clean reads have high margin, lower quality reads lower margin, and third allele at the SNP base or anz other circumstance gives a tie margin <1. 
Evidence for QD (which is essentially "how many perfect read equivalents are inside this locus sample pair") is calculated as the sum of all voting reads score margins divided bz the maximum possible margin per locus sample pair. This evidence_sum is then divided by depth (number of voting reads), dividing it bz depth makes the QD comparable between different pairs with different confidence for called genotype (depth). QD values range from 0 (all ties) - 1 (all perfect scores). Dividing bz depth give good sense of how confident the reads at each pair are.
But its  important to keep in mind that all the Q10 SNPs are filtered (optional) out in mz analysis for cleaner results with less noise cant go below a certain value (cca 0.3). Second important note, the calculated margins are in some sense also dependend on Q of the "fabricated primer" against which the reads are aligned. Higher the preassigned number, higher the possible maximum score and bigger differences when scoring against lower quality SNP bases.

Whole point of this index is to see if i can filter out the miscalls with certain threshold for lower qualitz reads. That is not the case with my reads. because nearly all miscalls are wrongly called HT (should be HM). All of them have really low depth with high quality SNP bases for minor (error) reads in HM. This is purely artifacts of low depth for mz simulated reads. If those were real, it could be a sign of cross contamination. 

Chunk contains to editable variables: minimum required depth threshold and QD quantile set to 1 %, currently arbitrary number of where the cutoff could be.

```{r QD_Parameter_Threshold_Analysis_and_Visualisation, eval = params$run_filtration_parameters, fig.width = 11.69, fig.height = 8.27, out.width = "100%"}

# QD (GATK-like) and alignment score-margin analysis. 
# Seperate paths for different types of genotypes
qd_asp_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "QD_margin_analysis")
qd_bayes_dir <- file.path(bayes_run_graphics_dir, "QD_margin_analysis")
dir.create(qd_asp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(qd_bayes_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Editable variables
qd_minimum_required_depth <- 10 
margin_cutoff <- 1 # When scores of two primrs barely differ, need for last plot (ties)
qd_flag_quantile <- 0.01 # cut-off is the bottom 1 % of QD across all calls, arbitrary cutoff

### QD Plots: One point per genotype, the same three plots use per method genotype table, all three plots are created inside a function.
# Data preparation
qd_make_plots <- function(genotype_table, method_name, folder) {
  qd_data <- genotype_table %>%
    filter(status == "called") %>%
    transmute(sample = barcode, locus, genotype, depth, QD) %>%
    mutate(zygosity_call = ifelse(substr(genotype, 1, 1) == substr(genotype, 2, 2), "Homozygous", "Heterozygous")) %>%
    left_join(ref %>% select(sample, locus, reference_genotype = genotype), by = c("sample", "locus")) %>%
    mutate(call_status = case_when(is.na(reference_genotype) ~ "No reference",
                                   genotype == reference_genotype ~ "Correct",
                                   TRUE ~ "Miscalled"))
  qd_flag_threshold <- quantile(qd_data$QD, qd_flag_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)

  # QD vs depth for every called genotype pai split by HM/HT with miscalled genotypes drawn in red
  qd_points <- qd_data %>%
    mutate(zygosity_call = factor(zygosity_call, levels = c("Heterozygous", "Homozygous")),
           low_qd = !is.na(QD) & QD < qd_flag_threshold,
           low_depth = depth < qd_minimum_required_depth)

# Labels for each panel of the QD vs Depth plot for HM and HT separately, counts the miscalls,removed by filter, correct call removed by filter and so on.
  qd_loss_labels <- qd_points %>%
    group_by(zygosity_call) %>%
    summarise(n_correct = sum(call_status == "Correct"),
              lost_depth = sum(call_status == "Correct" & low_depth),
              lost_qd = sum(call_status == "Correct" & low_qd),
              lost_both_filters = sum(call_status == "Correct" & (low_depth | low_qd)),
              n_miscalled = sum(call_status == "Miscalled"),
              miscalls_removed = sum(call_status == "Miscalled" & (low_depth | low_qd)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("Correct calls removed\ndepth filter: %d, QD filter: %d\nboth filters together: %d of %d (%.1f%%)\n%s",
                           lost_depth, lost_qd, lost_both_filters, n_correct, 100 * lost_both_filters / pmax(1, n_correct),
                           ifelse(n_miscalled == 0, "No miscalls", sprintf("Miscalls removed: %d of %d", miscalls_removed, n_miscalled))))

# Box for the label, on the right side of the data
  qd_label_x <- max(qd_points$depth)
  qd_label_y <- min(qd_points$QD, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 * diff(range(qd_points$QD, na.rm = TRUE))
  qd_shape_keys <- intersect(c("Correct", "Miscalled", "No reference"), unique(qd_points$call_status))
  
  p_qd_vs_depth <- ggplot(qd_points, aes(x = depth, y = QD)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1e-3, xmax = qd_minimum_required_depth, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = error_colour, alpha = 0.08) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = qd_minimum_required_depth, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = qd_flag_threshold, fill = error_colour, alpha = 0.08) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = qd_flag_threshold, linetype = "QD and depth cutoffs"), colour = "grey50") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = qd_minimum_required_depth, linetype = "QD and depth cutoffs"), colour = "grey50", show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = filter(qd_points, call_status == "Correct"), aes(colour = zygosity_call, shape = "Correct"), alpha = 0.45, size = 1.6) +
    geom_point(data = filter(qd_points, call_status == "No reference"), aes(shape = "No reference"), colour = "grey55", size = 1.6) +
    geom_point(data = filter(qd_points, call_status == "Miscalled"), aes(shape = "Miscalled"), colour = error_colour, size = 2.8) +
    geom_label(data = qd_loss_labels, aes(x = qd_label_x, y = qd_label_y, label = label), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3, lineheight = 1,
               fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2, label.padding = unit(5, "pt")) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = range(qd_points$depth), oob = oob_keep) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Heterozygous = ht_dark, Homozygous = hm_dark), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Correct = 16, Miscalled = 16, `No reference` = 1), name = NULL,
                       labels = c(Correct = "Correct call", Miscalled = "Miscalled", `No reference` = "No reference")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`QD and depth cutoffs` = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(colour = c(Correct = "grey30", Miscalled = error_colour, `No reference` = "grey55")[qd_shape_keys], alpha = 1, size = c(Correct = 2, Miscalled = 2.8, `No reference` = 2)[qd_shape_keys])),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = "grey50"), theme = theme(legend.key.width = unit(22, "pt")))) + 
    facet_wrap(~zygosity_call, ncol = 1) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s: QD vs. depth", method_name),
         subtitle = sprintf("QD flag cutoff: %.3f, min. required depth: %d", qd_flag_threshold, qd_minimum_required_depth),
         x = "Depth (log scale)",
         y = "QD") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.text = element_text(margin = margin(l = 5)), # Same gap between keys
          legend.key.spacing.x = unit(18, "pt"), 
          legend.spacing = unit(18, "pt"), 
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  print(p_qd_vs_depth)
  
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_vs_depth_scatter.png"), p_qd_vs_depth, width = 7, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_vs_depth_scatter.pdf"), p_qd_vs_depth, width = 7, height = 10, device = cairo_pdf)
  

# Every called genotype per point, correct calls are split into HM and HT, calls without a reference are in the separate row
  qd_status_points <- qd_data %>%
    mutate(row = case_when(call_status == "Correct" & zygosity_call == "Heterozygous" ~ "Correct HT",
                           call_status == "Correct" ~ "Correct HM",
                           TRUE ~ call_status))
  qd_status_rows <- c("Correct HM", "Correct HT", "No reference", "Miscalled") # for ordering
  qd_status_counts <- table(factor(qd_status_points$row, levels = qd_status_rows))
  qd_status_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (%d)", qd_status_rows, as.integer(qd_status_counts)), qd_status_rows) # Row name with nubmer of calls
  qd_status_points <- mutate(qd_status_points, row = factor(row, levels = qd_status_rows))
  
# Label for the daashed line above the top row with an arrow
  qd_range <- diff(range(qd_status_points$QD, na.rm = TRUE))
  qd_status_label_x <- qd_flag_threshold + 0.07 * qd_range 
  qd_status_label_y <- length(qd_status_rows) + 0.75 

p_qd_by_status <- ggplot(qd_status_points, aes(x = QD, y = row, colour = row, shape = call_status)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = qd_flag_threshold, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_jitter(data = filter(qd_status_points, row != "Miscalled"), height = 0.15, width = 0, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(data = filter(qd_status_points, row == "Miscalled"), height = 0.15, width = 0, size = 2.8) + # same red points for miscalls
     annotate("curve", x = qd_status_label_x - 0.015 * qd_range, y = qd_status_label_y, xend = qd_flag_threshold + 0.012 * qd_range, yend = qd_status_label_y - 0.5, curvature = 0.3, arrow = arrow(length = unit(5, "pt"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
    annotate("label", x = qd_status_label_x, y = qd_status_label_y, hjust = 0, size = 3.4, colour = "grey20", lineheight = 0.95,
             fill = "white", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(3, "pt"), # white box without a border
             label = sprintf("QD flag cutoff = %.3f (%d)",
                             qd_flag_threshold, sum(qd_status_points$QD < qd_flag_threshold, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Correct HM` = hm_dark, `Correct HT` = ht_dark, `No reference` = "grey55", Miscalled = error_colour), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Correct = 16, Miscalled = 16, `No reference` = 1), name = NULL,
                       limits = c("Correct", "Miscalled", "No reference"), 
                       labels = c(Correct = "Correct call", Miscalled = "Miscalled", `No reference` = "No reference")) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = qd_status_labels, expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.3))) + 
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = "Do miscalled genotypes have lower QD?", x = "QD", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey15"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10))
  print(p_qd_by_status)
  
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_density_correct_vs_miscalled_point.png"), p_qd_by_status, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_density_correct_vs_miscalled_point.pdf"), p_qd_by_status, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  

# Number of calls per depth bin (log scale), HT and HM separately, median and IQR of each in the legend with red ticks at the bottom for miscalled genotypes.
    qd_depth_bin_width <- 0.1 # bin width in log10 units (0.1 = 10 bins per tenfold change in depth)

  # light but solid fills so it looks like alpha effect, so HT drawn over HM stays clean green instead of mixing
  qd_tint <- function(colour, strength) rgb(t(strength * col2rgb(colour) / 255 + (1 - strength)))
  qd_zygosity_fills <- c(HT = qd_tint(ht_dark, 0.55), HM = qd_tint(hm_dark, 0.45))
  qd_zygosity_edges <- c(HT = ht_dark, HM = hm_dark) # Darker edge
  qd_depth_data <- mutate(qd_data, zygosity_short = ifelse(zygosity_call == "Heterozygous", "HT", "HM"))

# Median and IQR data prep
  qd_depth_groups <- qd_depth_data %>%
    group_by(zygosity_short) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), median_depth = median(depth), q25 = quantile(depth, 0.25), q75 = quantile(depth, 0.75), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(legend_label = sprintf("%s (n = %d): median %s, IQR %s-%s", zygosity_short, n,
                                  comma(median_depth), comma(q25), comma(q75)))
  
  qd_depth_labels <- setNames(qd_depth_groups$legend_label, qd_depth_groups$zygosity_short)
  qd_depth_removed <- filter(qd_depth_data, depth < qd_minimum_required_depth) # what the depth filter removes, by call status
  qd_depth_removed_title <- "Removed by the depth filter:" 
  qd_depth_removed_label <- sprintf("%d calls (%.1f%%)\n%d correct, %d miscalled,\n%d no reference", # separate boxes so the crossing line looks better
                                    nrow(qd_depth_removed), 100 * nrow(qd_depth_removed) / nrow(qd_depth_data),
                                    sum(qd_depth_removed$call_status == "Correct"), sum(qd_depth_removed$call_status == "Miscalled"),
                                    sum(qd_depth_removed$call_status == "No reference"))

  # label position, right of the depth line near the top, arrow into the shaded area
  qd_depth_tallest_bin <- max(table(qd_depth_data$zygosity_short, floor(log10(qd_depth_data$depth) / qd_depth_bin_width))) # height of the tallest bar
  qd_depth_label_x <- max(qd_minimum_required_depth, 0.8 * min(qd_depth_data$depth)) * 1.15
  qd_depth_label_y <- 0.9 * qd_depth_tallest_bin

  # Plot
  p_depth_all <- ggplot(qd_depth_data, aes(x = depth)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 1e-3, xmax = qd_minimum_required_depth, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = error_colour, alpha = 0.08) +
    geom_histogram(data = filter(qd_depth_data, zygosity_short == "HM"), aes(y = after_stat(ifelse(count == 0, NA, count)), fill = zygosity_short, colour = zygosity_short), binwidth = qd_depth_bin_width, linewidth = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_histogram(data = filter(qd_depth_data, zygosity_short == "HT"), aes(y = after_stat(ifelse(count == 0, NA, count)), fill = zygosity_short, colour = zygosity_short), binwidth = qd_depth_bin_width, linewidth = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE) + # HT drawn on top of HM it stays visible
    geom_vline(data = qd_depth_groups, aes(xintercept = median_depth, colour = zygosity_short), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = qd_minimum_required_depth, linetype = "dashed", colour = error_colour, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_rug(data = filter(qd_depth_data, call_status == "Miscalled"), aes(linetype = "Miscalled"), sides = "b", colour = error_colour,
             linewidth = 0.9, length = unit(0.04, "npc"), key_glyph = "vline") + ## ticks for miscalls
    annotate("curve", x = qd_depth_label_x * 0.95, y = qd_depth_label_y, xend = qd_minimum_required_depth * 0.7, yend = qd_depth_label_y * 0.8,
             curvature = 0.25, arrow = arrow(length = unit(5, "pt"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30") +
    annotate("label", x = qd_depth_label_x, y = qd_depth_label_y, label = qd_depth_removed_title, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.2, colour = "grey20",
             fill = "white", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(1, "pt")) + 
    annotate("label", x = qd_depth_label_x, y = qd_depth_label_y, label = qd_depth_removed_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.2, colour = "grey20",
             lineheight = 0.95, fill = "white", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(1, "pt")) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = range(qd_depth_data$depth) * c(0.8, 1.25), oob = oob_keep, labels = label_comma()) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = qd_zygosity_fills, labels = qd_depth_labels, breaks = c("HT", "HM"), name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = qd_zygosity_edges, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Miscalled = "solid"), name = NULL) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1, override.aes = list(colour = unname(qd_zygosity_edges[c("HT", "HM")]))),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = error_colour, linewidth = 0.9),
                                   theme = theme(legend.key.width = unit(4, "pt")))) +
    labs(title = "Read depth of the called genotypes",
         x = "Depth (log scale)",
         y = "Number of calls") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)), 
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5, margin = margin(l = 5)), # same gap between every key and its label
          legend.key.size = unit(14, "pt"), 
          legend.key.spacing.x = unit(18, "pt"), 
          legend.spacing = unit(18, "pt"), 
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), # no extra margin around each legend
          legend.box.spacing = unit(10, "pt"), 
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  print(p_depth_all)
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "depth_density_all_calls.png"), p_depth_all, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "depth_density_all_calls.pdf"), p_depth_all, width = 9, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)

# Comingin all thre plot into one panel
  qd_panel_title_theme <- theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 13),
                                plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9.5),
                                plot.title.position = "plot")
# unified legend style for both rows
  qd_legend_one_row_theme <- theme(legend.box = "horizontal", 
                                   legend.location = "plot", 
                                   legend.justification = "left",
                                   legend.spacing.x = unit(8, "pt"), 
                                   legend.key.size = unit(14, "pt"), 
                                   legend.key.spacing.x = unit(6, "pt"), 
                                   legend.text = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(l = 4)))
  p_qd_overview <- wrap_plots(
    p_qd_vs_depth + labs(title = "A  QD vs. depth", subtitle = NULL) + qd_panel_title_theme + 
      qd_legend_one_row_theme, 
    wrap_plots(free(p_depth_all + labs(title = "B  Read depth of the called genotypes") + qd_panel_title_theme + qd_legend_one_row_theme, 
                                          type = "label", side = "l"), 
                          p_qd_by_status + labs(title = "C  Do miscalled genotypes have lower QD?") + qd_panel_title_theme + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                          ncol = 1),
    ncol = 2, widths = c(1.1, 1.3)) + # A a bit wider, so its legend fits in one row
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: QD and read depth of the called genotypes", method_name),
                               theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)))
  print(p_qd_overview)
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_depth_overview.png"), p_qd_overview, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(folder, "qd_depth_overview.pdf"), p_qd_overview, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, device = cairo_pdf)
}
```
