## SNP quality analysis - split violin and ECDF  
This chunk contains data prep and plots for SNP quality analysis. First plot is ECDF (Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function), it plots % of reads up to each specific SNP Quality for called vs not called reads. No calls is split by reason - SNP low quality filter. It shows it separately, because one could assume reads accumulate faster at low SNP quality for no call reads, it shows that is not the case. No call reads accumulate faster at lower Q even without the filter. Second plot shows a split violin plot for SNP Quality of the major and minor allele reads for HM and HT final genotype pairs. It also contains a paired test per pair and two checks for robustness.

```{r SNP_Quality_Analysis_ECDF, eval = params$run_filtration_parameters, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, out.width = "100%"}
stopifnot("run the setup chunk first (dataset_name, min_snp_quality)" = exists("dataset_name") && exists("min_snp_quality"),
          "run the FS chunk first (fs_calls)" = exists("fs_calls"),
          "install the lme4 package: install.packages('lme4')" = requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE))

# Output paths
out_dir_snpq <- file.path(graphics_dir, "SNP_Quality_by_Locus")
dir.create(out_dir_snpq, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

snpq_threshold <- 20 # reference threshold for the % labels on the ECDF
snpq_quality_ceiling <- 90 # limit for base Q scores

# Importing reads and filtering for those with found SNP base quality
snpq_reads <- read_tsv(asp_reads_path,
                       col_select = c(barcode, locus, called_allele, snp_position_quality, snp_low_quality),
                       col_types = cols(barcode = "c", locus = "c", called_allele = "c", snp_position_quality = "d", snp_low_quality = "l")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(snp_position_quality))

# 1. Plot ECDF
# No calls are split by reason because one of the filter arelardy filter for low SNP quality
snpq_call_group_colours <- c("Called" = correct_colour, "No call: other reasons" = "#7F919B", "No call: low SNP quality" = "#D9B44A")

snpq_reads_by_call_group <- snpq_reads %>%
  mutate(call_group = factor(case_when(!is.na(called_allele) ~ "Called",
                                       snp_low_quality ~ "No call: low SNP quality",
                                       TRUE ~ "No call: other reasons"),
                                       levels = names(snpq_call_group_colours)))

# % of below the theresohld reads by call group
snpq_pct_below_threshold <- snpq_reads_by_call_group %>%
  group_by(call_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), pct_below = 100 * mean(snp_position_quality < snpq_threshold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", pct_below))

kable(snpq_pct_below_threshold, digits = 1)

# Labels for the plot
snpq_legend_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", snpq_pct_below_threshold$call_group, comma(snpq_pct_below_threshold$n)),
                               snpq_pct_below_threshold$call_group)
p_snpq_ecdf <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = c(min_snp_quality, snpq_threshold), xend = c(min_snp_quality, snpq_threshold), y = -Inf, yend = 102,
           linetype = c("dotted", "dashed"), colour = "grey40", linewidth = c(0.6, 0.5)) + 
  annotate("label", x = c(min_snp_quality, snpq_threshold), y = 103.3, label = c(paste0("Q", min_snp_quality, " filter"), paste0("Q", snpq_threshold)),
           size = 3.4, colour = "grey25", fill = "white", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) +
  stat_ecdf(data = snpq_reads_by_call_group, aes(x = snp_position_quality, y = after_stat(ecdf * 100), group = interaction(locus, call_group), colour = call_group),
            geom = "step", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.35) + 
  stat_ecdf(data = snpq_reads_by_call_group, aes(x = snp_position_quality, y = after_stat(ecdf * 100), colour = call_group),
            geom = "step", linewidth = 1.5) + # pooled curve
  geom_point(data = snpq_pct_below_threshold, aes(x = snpq_threshold, y = pct_below, fill = call_group),
             shape = 21, size = 3.2, colour = "white", stroke = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = snpq_pct_below_threshold, aes(x = snpq_threshold, y = pct_below, label = label, colour = call_group), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.9,
             size = 4, fontface = "bold", fill = "white", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = snpq_call_group_colours, labels = snpq_legend_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = snpq_call_group_colours, guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1.5))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 105), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0))) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60)) + 
  labs(title = "No-call reads have lower SNP quality than called reads, even when not rejected for quality",
       x = "SNP quality", y = "Cumulative % of reads") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5), plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.49), legend.justification = c(1, 0.5), # centred on the 50 % line
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey85"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_snpq_ecdf)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_snpq, "snp_quality_ecdf_by_locus_with_pooled.png"), p_snpq_ecdf, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white") 
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_snpq, "snp_quality_ecdf_by_locus_with_pooled.pdf"), p_snpq_ecdf, width = 11, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r SNP_Quality_Analysis_Split_Violin, eval = params$run_filtration_parameters, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7, out.width = "80%"}
### Split violin plots showing SNP quality of called reads from major and minor reads split by HM and HT 

snpq_allele_colours <- c("HM major" = hm_dark, "HM minor" = hm_light, "HT major" = ht_dark, "HT minor" = ht_light)

# Data prep, every votings read with the paris zygosity and call status
snpq_voting_reads <- snpq_reads %>%
  filter(!is.na(called_allele)) %>%
  inner_join(fs_calls %>% select(barcode = sample, locus, zygosity_call, call_status), by = c("barcode", "locus")) %>%
  add_count(barcode, locus, called_allele, name = "allele_reads") %>% 
  group_by(barcode, locus) %>%
  mutate(allele_role = ifelse(called_allele == called_allele[which.max(allele_reads)], "major", "minor")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(zygosity = factor(ifelse(zygosity_call == "Heterozygous", "Heterozygous (HT)", "Homozygous (HM)"),
                           levels = c("Homozygous (HM)", "Heterozygous (HT)")), #level order for plot
         allele_group = factor(paste(ifelse(zygosity_call == "Heterozygous", "HT", "HM"), allele_role), levels = names(snpq_allele_colours)))

# Medians and read counts for labels
snpq_allele_summary <- snpq_voting_reads %>%
  group_by(zygosity, allele_role) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_q = median(snp_position_quality), .groups = "drop")
kable(snpq_allele_summary, digits = 1)

# paired test: per pair, median SNP quality of its major vs its minor allele reads. Reads within each pair are not independent so each pair counts once (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test per zygosity)
snpq_pair_medians <- snpq_voting_reads %>%
  group_by(zygosity, barcode, locus, allele_role) %>%
  summarise(median_q = median(snp_position_quality), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = allele_role, values_from = median_q) %>%
  filter(!is.na(major), !is.na(minor)) %>% # only for pairs with reads for both minor and major
  mutate(difference = major - minor) 

snpq_paired_tests <- snpq_pair_medians %>%
  group_by(zygosity) %>%
  summarise(pairs = n(),
            median_difference = median(difference),
            p = wilcox.test(major, minor, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("major - minor: %+.0f Q, %s\n(paired Wilcoxon, %d pairs)", median_difference,
                         ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p)), pairs))
kable(select(snpq_paired_tests, -label), digits = 3, col.names = c("Zygosity", "Pairs", "Median difference (Q)", "p"))

# It asks whether major allele reads still have a higher SNP quality than minor reads when each locus counts only once. Pairs from the same locus aren't reallt independent, they share the same sequence, primers, probably errors
snpq_locus_tests <- snpq_pair_medians %>%
  group_by(zygosity, locus) %>%
  summarise(difference = median(difference), .groups = "drop") %>% # one value per locus
  group_by(zygosity) %>%
  summarise(loci = n(), median_difference = median(difference),
            p = wilcox.test(difference, mu = 0, exact = FALSE)$p.value, .groups = "drop")
kable(snpq_locus_tests, digits = 3, col.names = c("Zygosity", "Loci", "Median difference (Q)", "p"))

# Mixed model on the pair differences, it handles locus and sample at the same time. Interecpt is average major - minor difference after accounting for pairs sharing a sample or a locus. p-value is the likelihood-ratio test, the same model with and without the intercept (anova refits both with ML, needed to compare fixed effects)
snpq_mixed_model_tests <- snpq_pair_medians %>%
  group_by(zygosity) %>%
  group_modify(function(pairs, key) {
    full_model <- lmer(difference ~ 1 + (1 | barcode) + (1 | locus), data = pairs)
    no_intercept_model <- lmer(difference ~ 0 + (1 | barcode) + (1 | locus), data = pairs) # same model, average difference fixed at 0
    intercept <- summary(full_model)$coefficients[1, ]
    tibble(estimate = intercept[["Estimate"]], standard_error = intercept[["Std. Error"]],
           p = anova(no_intercept_model, full_model)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2])
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(snpq_mixed_model_tests, digits = 3, col.names = c("Zygosity", "Estimate (Q)", "SE", "p"))

# miscall reads as points, shifted onto the half of their allele role (left = major, right = minor)
snpq_miscall_points <- snpq_voting_reads %>%
  filter(call_status == "Miscalled") %>%
  mutate(x = as.numeric(zygosity) + ifelse(allele_role == "major", -0.12, 0.12))


# 2. Plot, split violin plots with split violin geom, odd groups are drawn as the left half, even groups as the right half.

GeomSplitViolin <- ggproto("GeomSplitViolin", GeomViolin,
  draw_group = function(self, data, ..., quantile_lines = NULL) {
    if ("quantile" %in% names(data)) data <- data[is.na(data$quantile), ]
    left_half <- data$group[1] %% 2 == 1
    centre_x <- data$x[1]
    data$edge_x <- if (left_half) data$x - data$violinwidth * (data$x - data$xmin) else data$x + data$violinwidth * (data$xmax - data$x)
    outline <- data[order(if (left_half) data$y else -data$y), ] # down one side, closed back at the centre line
    outline$x <- outline$edge_x
    outline <- rbind(transform(outline[1, ], x = centre_x), outline, transform(outline[nrow(outline), ], x = centre_x))
    violin_grob <- GeomPolygon$draw_panel(outline, ...)
    if (length(quantile_lines) == 0 || zero_range(range(data$y))) return(violin_grob)
    # quantile y = where the cumulative density reaches each quantile; each line runs from the centre to this half's edge only
    quantile_y <- approx(cumsum(data$density) / sum(data$density), data$y, xout = quantile_lines, ties = "ordered")$y
    quantile_edge <- approx(data$y, data$edge_x, xout = quantile_y, ties = "ordered")$y
    lines <- data[rep(1, 2 * length(quantile_y)), setdiff(names(data), c("x", "y", "group")), drop = FALSE]
    lines$x <- as.vector(rbind(centre_x, quantile_edge))
    lines$y <- rep(quantile_y, each = 2)
    lines$group <- rep(seq_along(quantile_y), each = 2)
    lines$alpha <- 1
    grobTree(violin_grob, GeomPath$draw_panel(lines, ...), name = grobName(prefix = "geom_split_violin")) 
  })

geom_split_violin <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "ydensity", position = "identity", ...,
                              quantile_lines = NULL, trim = TRUE, scale = "area", na.rm = FALSE, show.legend = NA, inherit.aes = TRUE) {
  layer(data = data, mapping = mapping, stat = stat, geom = GeomSplitViolin, position = position,
        show.legend = show.legend, inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
        params = list(trim = trim, scale = scale, quantile_lines = quantile_lines, na.rm = na.rm, ...))
}

p_snpq_split_violin <- ggplot(snpq_voting_reads, aes(x = zygosity, y = snp_position_quality, fill = allele_group)) +
  geom_split_violin(colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.85, quantile_lines = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  geom_point(data = snpq_miscall_points, aes(x = x, y = snp_position_quality, shape = "Reads of miscalled pairs"), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.04, height = 0, seed = 1),
             size = 2.4, fill = error_colour, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = snpq_allele_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(zygosity) + ifelse(allele_role == "major", -0.25, 0.25), y = 2,
                                            label = sprintf("median Q%.0f\nn = %s", median_q, comma(n))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2, colour = "grey20", lineheight = 0.9, vjust = 0) +
  geom_text(data = snpq_paired_tests, aes(x = as.numeric(zygosity), y = 97, label = label), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.3, colour = "grey15", lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = snpq_allele_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Reads of miscalled pairs" = 21), name = NULL) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
         shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(fill = error_colour, colour = "black", size = 3))) +
  # 90 is the highest value in the data: quality scores above it are written as 90
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, snpq_quality_ceiling), limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0))) +
  labs(title = "Minor allele reads in HM calls have lower SNP quality", x = NULL, y = "SNP quality") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5), plot.title.position = "plot", 
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(5.5, "pt"), 
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_snpq_split_violin)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_snpq, "snp_quality_major_minor_split_violin.png"), p_snpq_split_violin, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## MAF: confirmed HT vs confirmed HM 
This plot shows minor allele fraction (MAF) for every locus sample pair with depth > 10 and HT threshold hard coded in the master pipeline at 0.2. Pairs are grouped by their reference genotype, the two groups are clearly separated. HM pairs are gathered near zero, which is basically the pairs error rate and HT center at around 0.4 -0.5 which is also expected for true HT. 

```{r Minor_Allele_Fraction_HT_vs_HM, eval = params$run_filtration_parameters, fig.width = 8.27, fig.height = 5.85, out.width = "70%"}

# Output path
maf_out <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Minor_Allele_Fraction")
dir.create(maf_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

maf_min_reads <- 10 # minimum depth per pair

# Reference genotypes for comparison 
maf_truth <- ref %>%
  filter(grepl("^[ACGT]{2}$", genotype)) %>% 
  transmute(barcode = sample, locus, reference_genotype = genotype,
            true_class = ifelse(substr(genotype, 1, 1) == substr(genotype, 2, 2), "Confirmed homozygous", "Confirmed heterozygous"))
kable(count(maf_truth, true_class))

# MAF per pair for called reads only
maf_check <- read_tsv(asp_reads_path, col_select = c(barcode, locus, called_allele),
                      col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>% # T doesn't count as TRUE
  filter(!is.na(called_allele)) %>%
  count(barcode, locus, called_allele, name = "n_allele") %>%
  summarise(n_total = sum(n_allele), top_count = max(n_allele), .by = c(barcode, locus)) %>%
  mutate(minor_fraction = (n_total - top_count) / n_total) %>% 
  inner_join(maf_truth, by = c("barcode", "locus")) %>%
  left_join(select(asp_results, barcode, locus, asp_genotype = genotype), by = c("barcode", "locus")) %>%
  filter(n_total >= maf_min_reads)

maf_het <- filter(maf_check, true_class == "Confirmed heterozygous")
maf_hom <- filter(maf_check, true_class == "Confirmed homozygous")
stopifnot(nrow(maf_het) > 1, nrow(maf_hom) > 1)

# Summaries
maf_summary <- maf_check %>%
  group_by(true_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(minor_fraction), median = median(minor_fraction),
            p05 = quantile(minor_fraction, 0.05), p95 = quantile(minor_fraction, 0.95), .groups = "drop")
kable(maf_summary, digits = 3, col.names = c("Reference class", "Pairs", "Mean MAF", "Median MAF", "5th pct", "95th pct"))

# Checking for overalap with MAF between confirmed HM and HT
maf_het_median <- median(maf_het$minor_fraction)
maf_hom_overlap <- sum(maf_hom$minor_fraction >= maf_het_median)
cat(sprintf("Confirmed heterozygotes: median minor fraction %.3f\n", maf_het_median))
cat(sprintf("Confirmed homozygotes with minor fraction >= that value: %d / %d (%.1f %%)\n",
            maf_hom_overlap, nrow(maf_hom), 100 * maf_hom_overlap / nrow(maf_hom)))
cat(sprintf("Highest homozygote minor fraction: %.3f | lowest heterozygote minor fraction: %.3f\n",
            max(maf_hom$minor_fraction), min(maf_het$minor_fraction)))

# Miscall only
maf_miscalls <- maf_check %>%
  filter(!is.na(asp_genotype), asp_genotype != reference_genotype) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s %s\ncalled %s (true %s), %d reads", barcode, sub("_rs[0-9]+$", "", locus),
                         asp_genotype, reference_genotype, n_total))
kable(select(maf_miscalls, barcode, locus, reference_genotype, asp_genotype, n_total, minor_fraction), digits = 3)

# MAF plot
maf_cols <- c("Confirmed heterozygous" = ht_light, "Confirmed homozygous" = hm_light)
maf_edge_cols <- c("Confirmed heterozygous" = ht_dark, "Confirmed homozygous" = hm_dark)

maf_legend_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %d, median %.3f)", maf_summary$true_class, maf_summary$n, maf_summary$median),
                              maf_summary$true_class)

maf_y_top <- max(density(maf_hom$minor_fraction)$y) # height of the HM for label position

p_maf <- ggplot(maf_check, aes(x = minor_fraction, fill = true_class, colour = true_class)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0, alpha = 0.35, position = "identity") +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1, fill = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = HT_min_frequence, colour = "grey30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("label", x = HT_min_frequence, y = 0.95 * maf_y_top, label = "HT call threshold",
           size = 3.2, colour = "grey20", fill = "white", linewidth = 0) +
  geom_point(data = maf_miscalls, aes(x = minor_fraction, y = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 21, size = 3, fill = error_colour, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = maf_miscalls, aes(x = minor_fraction, xend = minor_fraction, y = 0.6, yend = 0.22 * maf_y_top), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               colour = error_colour, linewidth = 0.4) + 
  geom_label(data = maf_miscalls, aes(x = minor_fraction, y = 0.22 * maf_y_top, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             vjust = 0, size = 2.7, colour = error_colour, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.3, lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.5), clip = "off") + # minor fraction is 0 to 0.5 by definition
  scale_fill_manual(values = maf_cols, labels = maf_legend_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = maf_edge_cols, labels = maf_legend_labels, name = NULL) + 
  labs(title = sprintf("Minor allele fraction: confirmed heterozygotes vs. homozygotes (depth \u2265 %d)", maf_min_reads),
       x = "Minor allele fraction", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title.position = "plot") # centred over the whole figure, not only the panel

print(p_maf)
ggsave(file.path(maf_out, "het_vs_hom_overlay.png"), p_maf, width = 8.27, height = 5.85, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(maf_out, "het_vs_hom_overlay.pdf"), p_maf, width = 8.27, height = 5.85, device = cairo_pdf)
```



## Changes in scoring threshold visualized and difference in perfect score calculation 
This chunk contains visualization of at the start of the pipeline creation process arbitrarily picked 0.65 fraction of perfect score threshold and how the new updated changed the scoring and allowance of mismatches and indels per read. the first naive threshold was picked even before the master pipeline was quality aware, which means the alignment was calculated based on the same uniform quality of amplicons and ASP primers (Q22). What that means in practice, each read was scored with the same per base score, the length of the primer was the only deciding factor on how big the perfect score was. Setting the threshold to sit at 0.65 * perfect score of each primer was sensible choice as it sat somewhere in between one and two mismatches. After the introduction of read quality things changed, but the same threshold was kept for quite a long time because ti still kinda worked. Now that the read base qualities are in play and different possibilities of how to penalize indels things have to get a bit more sophisticated.
Each read now get its own perfect quality score calculated based on actual base qualities, this perfect score is then again the basis of the threshold. Indel penalty has now been lowered to 6 indel insertion and 2 for adding gaps, which is in line with other software for analysing Nanopore data. Indels are abundant and penalizing them even more and not taking into consideration the artifacts of Nanopore sequencing would be counter intuitive. But we still dont want that many indels because reads get noisy then, that is why they are capped at 1 indel per read (can be changed). The number of mismatches each read is allowed is now based on (error rate (0.08) * length of the primer * cost of one average quality (Q20) mismatch). All of this parameters can be changed. This makes the updated threshold now: perfect primer score - max(one indel cost, error rate * length * cost of one mismatch). Given the length of the primers, maximum is usually at around two mismatches. Additional option for master pipeline is ability to cap mismatches at certain values, i have it set on 2 mismatches.

```{r Changed_Scoring_Threshold_Visualized, eval = params$run_speedopt_diagnosis, fig.width = 8.27, fig.height = 10, out.width = "70%"}
stopifnot("run the setup chunk first" = exists("graphics_dir") && exists("max_mismatches"),
          "run the panel chunk first (panel, identified_file_names_f)" = exists("panel") && exists("identified_file_names_f"),
          "run the scorer chunk first (v8, match_lookup, mismatch_cost_lookup)" =
            exists("score_reads_against_primers_2pwalign_v8") && exists("match_lookup") && exists("mismatch_cost_lookup"))

# Output paths
qsim_out_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Quality_Scoring_Simulation")
dir.create(qsim_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Variables of the new threshold calculation
qsim_error_quality <- 20 # Quality of the mismatch base used for new threshold
qsim_error_cost <- mismatch_cost_lookup[qsim_error_quality + 1] # cost of one Q20 mismatch
qsim_indel_budget <- min_errors * (gap_opening + gap_extension + max(match_lookup)) # new updated budget
qsim_shortest_primer <- min(nchar(panel$asp1_seq) + nchar(panel$anchor)) # shortest primer + anchor of the panel

# 1. Plot Heatmap, number of mismatches allowed with the old rule and new updated

# Model read with the same quality at every base. Dots shows the mismatch cap which sets the limit
qsim_read_qualities <- 2:40 
qsim_primer_lengths <- qsim_shortest_primer:30 # primer lentgh from the shortest primer
qsim_count_colours <- c("0" = "#2C5724", "1" = "#55804D", "2" = "#A4B591", "3" = "#E1C473", "4" = "#C3722A", "5+" = "#834D24") #mismatches allowed
qsim_count_levels <- names(qsim_count_colours)
qsim_most_shown <- 5 # mismatches only to 5+

# Creates extra legend entry for capped values
qsim_has_cap <- is.finite(max_mismatches) # if it has a cap for example 2, this is TRUE
qsim_capped_label <- paste0(max_mismatches, " (capped)")
qsim_fill_levels <- if (qsim_has_cap) c(qsim_count_levels, qsim_capped_label) else qsim_count_levels
qsim_fill_colours <- if (qsim_has_cap) c(qsim_count_colours, setNames(qsim_count_colours[[min(max_mismatches, qsim_most_shown) + 1]], qsim_capped_label)) else qsim_count_colours # if it has a cap it joins them
qsim_legend_dot_sizes <- ifelse(qsim_fill_levels == qsim_capped_label, 1.6, 0) # dot for the capped key

# Data prep for heatmap, one row pwer tile for each rule
qsim_heatmap_tiles <- expand_grid(rule = c("fraction", "errors"), q_read = qsim_read_qualities, primer_len = qsim_primer_lengths) %>% #makes every combo
  mutate(perfect = primer_len * match_lookup[q_read + 1],
         allowed_loss = ifelse(rule == "fraction", (1 - min_score_fraction) * perfect, pmax(qsim_indel_budget, error_rate * primer_len * qsim_error_cost)),
         allowed_by_score = pmin(primer_len, floor(allowed_loss / mismatch_cost_lookup[q_read + 1] + 1e-9)), # New rule
         mismatch_cap = ifelse(rule == "errors", max_mismatches, Inf), # the old rule had no cap
         capped = allowed_by_score > mismatch_cap, # the cap, not the score budget, sets the limit here
         allowed = pmin(allowed_by_score, mismatch_cap),
         allowed_shown = factor(case_when(capped ~ qsim_capped_label,
                                          allowed >= qsim_most_shown ~ paste0(qsim_most_shown, "+"),
                                          TRUE ~ as.character(allowed)), levels = qsim_fill_levels))

# Panel titles
qsim_panel_titles <- c(fraction = sprintf("A  Old rule: score \u2265 %.2f \u00d7 perfect score (primer Q%d), allowed loss grows with primer length.", min_score_fraction, primer_quality),
                       errors = sprintf("B  New rule: one-indel budget, mismatches capped at %g", max_mismatches))
qsim_heatmap_tiles <- mutate(qsim_heatmap_tiles, panel = factor(qsim_panel_titles[rule], levels = qsim_panel_titles))

p_qsim_heatmap <- ggplot(qsim_heatmap_tiles, aes(q_read, primer_len, fill = allowed_shown)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, show.legend = TRUE) + 
  geom_point(data = filter(qsim_heatmap_tiles, capped), shape = 16, stroke = 0, size = 0.9, colour = "black", show.legend = TRUE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1, axes = "all") + # vertical
  scale_fill_manual(values = qsim_fill_colours, limits = qsim_fill_levels, drop = FALSE, name = "Mismatches\nallowed") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = qsim_legend_dot_sizes))) + # dots shown only for capped tiles
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = qsim_primer_lengths, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Mismatches an alignment may carry and still pass the score threshold",
       x = "Read quality (Phred)", y = "Primer + anchor length (bp)") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.title.position = "plot",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.1, face = "bold"), 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(12, "pt"))

print(p_qsim_heatmap)
ggsave(file.path(qsim_out_dir, sprintf("mismatches_allowed_old_vs_new_primer_Q%d.png", primer_quality)), p_qsim_heatmap,
       width = 8.27, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(qsim_out_dir, sprintf("mismatches_allowed_old_vs_new_primer_Q%d.pdf", primer_quality)), p_qsim_heatmap,
       width = 8.27, height = 10, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r Real_Base_Q_vs_Whole_Read_Mean, eval = params$run_speedopt_diagnosis, fig.width = 8.27, fig.height = 4.5, out.width = "70%"}
stopifnot("run the heatmap chunk first (qsim_out_dir)" = exists("qsim_out_dir"))
# 2. Plot showing difference between real per base quality perfect score calculation vs mean of the whole read. Old perfect score calculation used per red means, now i use actual per base qualities


qsim_example_barcode <- "01" # example
qsim_reads_per_locus <- 500 # number of reads scored (i just need to find one good example)
qsim_phred_f <- function(quality_string) utf8ToInt(quality_string) - 33

# the sample's identified FASTQ, same parsing
qsim_fastq_lines <- readLines(identified_file_names_f(qsim_example_barcode))
qsim_fastq_headers <- qsim_fastq_lines[seq(1, length(qsim_fastq_lines), 4)]
qsim_sample_reads <- tibble(read_id = sub("^@(\\S+).*", "\\1", qsim_fastq_headers),
                            locus = sub('.*"experiment":"([^"]*)".*', "\\1", qsim_fastq_headers),
                            direction = sub('.*"obimultiplex_direction":"([^"]*)".*', "\\1", qsim_fastq_headers),
                            seq = qsim_fastq_lines[seq(2, length(qsim_fastq_lines), 4)],
                            qual = qsim_fastq_lines[seq(4, length(qsim_fastq_lines), 4)])

# every locus scored with the scorer function, for finding where primer sits on the read 
qsim_scored_reads <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(panel)), function(panel_row) {
  locus_row <- panel[panel_row, ]
  locus_reads <- head(filter(qsim_sample_reads, locus == locus_row$locus), qsim_reads_per_locus)
  if (nrow(locus_reads) == 0) return(NULL)
  scored <- score_reads_against_primers_2pwalign_v8(DNAStringSet(locus_reads$seq), locus_reads$qual, locus_reads$direction,
                                                    locus_row$asp1_seq, locus_row$asp2_seq, locus_row$allele1, locus_row$allele2,
                                                    min_score_fraction, primer_quality = primer_quality, match_lookup = match_lookup,
                                                    gap_opening = gap_opening, gap_extension = gap_extension,
                                                    anchor = locus_row$anchor, input_type = input_type,
                                                    threshold_type = threshold_type, error_rate = error_rate,
                                                    min_errors = min_errors, min_snp_quality = min_snp_quality,
                                                    max_mismatches = max_mismatches, mismatch_cost_lookup = mismatch_cost_lookup,
                                                    probe_type = probe_type)
  asp1_wins <- scored$score1 >= scored$score2
  winning_primer <- paste0(ifelse(asp1_wins, locus_row$asp1_seq, locus_row$asp2_seq), locus_row$anchor) 
  scored_length <- nchar(winning_primer)
  flip <- grepl("_rc$", scored$winning_orientation) # the direction the scorer used (ASP: header direction on padded reads, reference: the better of the two alignments)
  winning_primer[flip] <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(winning_primer[flip])))
  winning_alignment <- pairwiseAlignment(DNAStringSet(locus_reads$seq), DNAStringSet(winning_primer), type = "local-global",
                                                  patternQuality = PhredQuality(locus_reads$qual),
                                                  subjectQuality = PhredQuality(as.integer(primer_quality)),
                                                  gapOpening = gap_opening, gapExtension = gap_extension)
  tibble(locus = locus_row$locus, read_id = locus_reads$read_id, qual = locus_reads$qual, scored_length = scored_length,
         whole_mean_q = vapply(locus_reads$qual, function(q) mean(qsim_phred_f(q)), numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
         mismatches = scored$winning_nmismatch,
         indels = scored$winning_indel_events,
         primer_start = start(pattern(winning_alignment)))
}))

# Hghest base quality of the read and the mean quality under the primer region
qsim_scored_reads <- qsim_scored_reads %>%
  mutate(region_quality = substr(qual, primer_start, primer_start + scored_length - 1),
         region_mean_q = vapply(region_quality, function(q) mean(qsim_phred_f(q)), numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
         max_q = vapply(qual, function(q) max(qsim_phred_f(q)), numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
         mean_gap = whole_mean_q - region_mean_q) # difference in means, actual errors when calculating perfect score

# Finding a clean read with primer alignment showing a clear difference with some filters to keep it clear
qsim_example_max_q <- 50 # base quality cap, for better looking plot
qsim_clean_reads <- filter(qsim_scored_reads, mismatches == 0, indels == 0, max_q <= qsim_example_max_q) # no mismatches or indels
stopifnot("no clean read in the searched reads: raise qsim_reads_per_locus or pick another qsim_example_barcode" = nrow(qsim_clean_reads) > 0)
qsim_example_read <- slice_max(qsim_clean_reads, mean_gap, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) # Finding a clean read with most difference between the means

# Preparing data for th bar chart, one bar per base with qualities as height
qsim_example_q <- qsim_phred_f(qsim_example_read$qual)
qsim_example_start <- qsim_example_read$primer_start
qsim_base_levels <- c("Primer bases", "Other read bases")
qsim_example_bases <- tibble(position = seq_along(qsim_example_q), q = qsim_example_q,
                             base_group = factor(ifelse(position >= qsim_example_start & position < qsim_example_start + qsim_example_read$scored_length,
                                                        qsim_base_levels[1], qsim_base_levels[2]), levels = qsim_base_levels))

# Legend entry prep for the two means
qsim_mean_levels <- c(sprintf("Whole-read mean, Q%.1f", qsim_example_read$whole_mean_q),
                      sprintf("Primer-region mean, Q%.1f", qsim_example_read$region_mean_q))
qsim_mean_lines <- tibble(mean_type = factor(qsim_mean_levels, levels = qsim_mean_levels),
                          q = c(qsim_example_read$whole_mean_q, qsim_example_read$region_mean_q))

# Colours
qsim_base_fills <- setNames(c("#A9BA84", "#E6D6C8"), qsim_base_levels)
qsim_base_edges <- setNames(c("#76825C", "#A1968C"), qsim_base_levels)
qsim_mean_colours <- setNames(c("#A3845F", "#55693F"), qsim_mean_levels)

# Plot
p_qsim_example_read <- ggplot(qsim_example_bases, aes(position, q)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = qsim_example_start - 0.5, xmax = qsim_example_start + qsim_example_read$scored_length - 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F1E4DB", alpha = 0.8) + 
  geom_col(aes(fill = base_group, colour = base_group), width = 0.8, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_hline(data = qsim_mean_lines, aes(yintercept = q, linetype = mean_type, colour = mean_type), linewidth = 0.9, key_glyph = "path") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = qsim_base_fills, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(qsim_base_edges, qsim_mean_colours), breaks = qsim_mean_levels, name = NULL) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "dashed"), qsim_mean_levels), name = NULL) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(colour = unname(qsim_base_edges), alpha = 0.8)),
         colour = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1), linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = sprintf("Read %s (%s): per-base quality vs. the two perfect-score means", substr(qsim_example_read$read_id, 1, 8), qsim_example_read$locus),
       x = "Read position", y = "Base quality (Phred)") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title.position = "plot", 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = unit(22, "pt"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5))

print(p_qsim_example_read)
ggsave(file.path(qsim_out_dir, "real_read_quality.png"), p_qsim_example_read, width = 8.27, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white") 
ggsave(file.path(qsim_out_dir, "real_read_quality.pdf"), p_qsim_example_read, width = 8.27, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
```


## Speed optimization analysis - basic bar plots 

These three plots show progress of speed optimization analysis from naive v1 to last v11 with all the updates. Plots both for small and big dataset and comparison of reads per second for the big data set.

```{r Speed_Optimization_Analysis, eval = params$run_speedopt_diagnosis, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, out.width = "100%"}
# Shared editable variables and helper functions. This chunk always compares both data sets, small and big.
# Folders for timing logs and output paths
speed_logs_small <- "Results/small/Genotypes_results/old/Identified_ASP_genotypes"
speed_logs_big <- "Results/big/Genotypes_results/old/Identified_ASP_genotypes"
out_dir_speed_opt_small <- "Results/small/Graphics/Speed_Optimization_Analysis"
out_dir_speed_opt <- "Results/big/Graphics/Speed_Optimization_Analysis"
dir.create(out_dir_speed_opt_small, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_speed_opt, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

locus_row_regex <- "^\\[locus \\d+/\\d+\\] (\\S+) \\((\\d+) reads" #[locus 3/33] BICF2G630340139, group 1 for loci, group 2 for reads

#labels
speed_label <- function(before, after) {
  ifelse(after <= before, sprintf("%.1fx faster", before / after), sprintf("%.1fx slower", after / before))
}

# Plot function for both dataset using total time and added arrows
plot_total_time_f <- function(totals, palette, from_bar, to_bar, title, show_minutes) {
  y_max <- max(totals$total_seconds)
  label_gap <- y_max * 0.08 # space between a bar and the start of its arrow
  x_inset <- 0.32 # keeps the arrows off the bars

  bars <- totals %>%
    mutate(label = if (show_minutes) sprintf("%.0fs\n(%.1f min)", total_seconds, total_seconds / 60) else sprintf("%.1fs", total_seconds))

  # Arrows spacing and positioning
  arrows <- tibble(x = from_bar + x_inset,
                   xend = to_bar - x_inset,
                   y = totals$total_seconds[from_bar] + label_gap,
                   yend = totals$total_seconds[to_bar] + label_gap,
                   label = speed_label(totals$total_seconds[from_bar], totals$total_seconds[to_bar])) %>%
    mutate(x_mid = (x + xend) / 2, 
           y_label = (y + yend) / 2 + y_max * 0.12)

  y_top <- max(arrows$y_label, arrows$y, totals$total_seconds + label_gap) * 1.15 

  # Plot
  ggplot(bars, aes(x = version, y = total_seconds, fill = version)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold", size = 4, colour = "#0b0b0b") +
    geom_curve(data = arrows, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               curvature = -0.3, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#52514e",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.16, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
    geom_label(data = arrows, aes(x = x_mid, y = y_label, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", colour = "#0b0b0b",
               fill = "#fcfcfb", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06)), limits = c(0, y_top)) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = "\n* v1 is not a real speed comparison - does less work per read.",
         x = NULL,
         y = "Total pipeline time (seconds)") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#0b0b0b", margin = margin(b = 4)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#52514e"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 14, b = 8, l = 8),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#52514e"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#898781"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "#52514e"))
}

# Plot for small dataset
v1_naive_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v1_old_naive_genotyper/very_first_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v2_Qscores_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v2_quality_scoring_before_restructuring/original_fixed_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v3_Qscore_restructured_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v3_quality_scoring_restructured/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v4_parallel_4pwalign_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v4_quality_scoring_parallel_4pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v5_parallel_2pwalign_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v5_quality_scoring_parallel_2pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v6_final_anchored_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v11_3anchors_agreementTRUE_strand_check/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Total time needed for finishing the analysis
v1_total_small <- filter(v1_naive_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v2_total_small <- sum(filter(v2_Qscores_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds) # no total pipeline log, summing over the steps
v3_total_small <- filter(v3_Qscore_restructured_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v4_total_small <- filter(v4_parallel_4pwalign_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_total_small <- filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v6_total_small <- filter(v6_final_anchored_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_scoring_small <- sum(filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds) # again summed over loci
v6_scoring_small <- sum(filter(v6_final_anchored_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds)

# Bar colours in order
palette_small <- c(
  "First naive function (v1)\n(no QPhred scores)*" = "#72874E",
  "QPhred aware\n function (v2)" = "#AB5D26",
  "Restructured v2" = "#C3722A",
  "Restructured v2 +\n parallel (7 cores)" = "#E6DAB9",
  "Direction-aware\n2x pairwiseAlignment" = "#E1C473",
  "Final: anchors +\nposition & strand checks" = "#2C5724")

totals_small <- tibble(version = factor(names(palette_small), levels = names(palette_small)),
                       total_seconds = c(v1_total_small, v2_total_small, v3_total_small, v4_total_small, v5_total_small, v6_total_small))

# arrows from 2 to 3 and 3 to 4 and so on.
plot_total_time_small <- plot_total_time_f(totals_small, palette_small, from_bar = c(2, 3, 5), to_bar = c(3, 4, 6),
                                           title = "Small dataset: total pipeline runtime across every version", show_minutes = FALSE)
print(plot_total_time_small)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt_small, "small_dataset_total.png"), plot_total_time_small, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt_small, "small_dataset_total.pdf"), plot_total_time_small, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

kable(transmute(totals_small, version = gsub("\n", " ", version), seconds = round(total_seconds, 1),
                faster_than_v2 = round(v2_total_small / total_seconds, 2)))

# Plot for the big dataset
v1_naive_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v1_old_naive_genotyper/very_first_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v2_Qscores_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v2_quality_scoring_before_restructuring/original_fixed_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v4_parallel_4pwalign_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v4_quality_scoring_parallel_4pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v5_parallel_2pwalign_7cores_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v5_quality_scoring_parallel_2pwalign_7cores/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v6_final_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v11_3anchors_agreementTRUE_strand_check/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# these five names are used by the spiral chunk
v1_naive_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v1_naive_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v2_Qscores_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v4_parallel_4pwalign_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_7cores_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v6_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v6_final_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds

# number of reads in the big dataset
n_reads_total_big <- sum(as.integer(sub(paste0(locus_row_regex, ".*"), "\\2", grep(locus_row_regex, v4_parallel_4pwalign_big$step, value = TRUE))))

palette_big <- c(
  "First naive function (v1)\n(no QPhred scores)*" = "#72874E",
  "QPhred aware\n function (v2)" = "#AB5D26",
  "Restructured v2 +\n parallel (3 cores)" = "#E6DAB9",
  "Direction-aware\n2x pairwiseAlignment (7 cores)" = "#E1C473",
  "Final: anchors +\nposition & strand checks" = "#2C5724")

totals_big <- tibble(version = factor(names(palette_big), levels = names(palette_big)),
                     total_seconds = c(v1_naive_pipeline_total_big, v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big, v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big,
                                       v5_pipeline_total_big, v6_pipeline_total_big)) %>%
  mutate(reads_per_sec = n_reads_total_big / total_seconds)

# arrows similar as before
plot_total_time_big <- plot_total_time_f(totals_big, palette_big, from_bar = c(2, 3, 4), to_bar = c(3, 4, 5),
                                         title = sprintf("Big dataset (%s reads): total pipeline time", format(n_reads_total_big, big.mark = ",")),
                                         show_minutes = TRUE)
print(plot_total_time_big)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_total_pipeline.png"), plot_total_time_big, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_total_pipeline.pdf"), plot_total_time_big, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

# reads processed per second
plot_reads_per_second_big <- ggplot(totals_big, aes(x = version, y = reads_per_sec, fill = version)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_big, guide = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(totals_big$reads_per_sec) * 1.15) +
  labs(title = "Big dataset: throughput (reads processed per second)",
       subtitle = "* v1's higher throughput reflects doing less per read, not a faster algorithm - see total-time chart",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Reads / second") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(plot_reads_per_second_big)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_throughput.png"), plot_reads_per_second_big, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_throughput.pdf"), plot_reads_per_second_big, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

# time of each part of the final run and banners
phase_df_big <- v6_final_big %>%
  filter(grepl("^Part [123] total", step)) %>%
  mutate(phase = substr(step, 1, 6), pct = 100 * seconds / v6_pipeline_total_big)

kable(transmute(totals_big, version = gsub("\n", " ", version), seconds = round(total_seconds), minutes = round(total_seconds / 60, 1),
                reads_per_sec = round(reads_per_sec), faster_than_v2 = round(v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big / total_seconds, 1)))

cat(sprintf("  v2 -> v4: %s | v5 -> final: %s | v2 -> final: %s\n",
            speed_label(v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big, v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big),
            speed_label(v5_pipeline_total_big, v6_pipeline_total_big),

cat(sprintf("  Phase breakdown (final run): %s\n",
            paste(sprintf("%s = %.1fs (%.1f%%)", phase_df_big$phase, phase_df_big$seconds, phase_df_big$pct), collapse = ", ")))
cat(" * v1 is not an apples-to-apples speed comparison - see plot subtitles.\n")
```
