## Du Bois plots for speed optimization analysis and SNP read base quality 
This chunk contains plots for SNP read base qaulity and speed optimization using Du Bois data visualization as refernce for the plot with changed colours. Code for this was built by Pat Schloss (Riffomonas), I just used my data (https://riffomonas.org/code_club/2025-02-17-panel-27).

```{r Du_Bois_Plots_for_Speed_Optimization_Analysis_and_SNP_Quality, eval = params$run_speedopt_diagnosis, results = "asis", fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 7, out.width = "55%"}
# Du Bois plate 27 style pies: quality of the read base on the SNP. First pie plot showing SNP read base quality of the correctly and wrongly called reads in HM pairs. Second plot shows SNP read base quality of the rarer allele in reads from HM (error or noise) and HT (actual real second allele just lower freq).

# Settings
out_dir_Dubois <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Dubois_plots")
dir.create(out_dir_Dubois, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pie_out_right_wrong <- file.path(out_dir_Dubois, sprintf("%sdataset_dubois_snp_quality_pie.png", dataset_name))
pie_out_rare_allele <- file.path(out_dir_Dubois, sprintf("%sdataset_dubois_minority_allele_quality_pie.png", dataset_name))

# Quality groups, q4 is best
pie_categories <- c("q4", "q3", "q2", "q1")
pie_fills <- c(q4 = "#A4B591FF", q3 = "#E1C473FF", q2 = "#C3722AFF", q1 = "#A12A19FF")
pie_legend <- tribble(
  ~x_dot, ~x_label, ~y, ~category, ~label,
  -0.90, -0.84, 0.12, "q4", "Q30 AND OVER",
  -0.90, -0.84, -0.12, "q3", "Q20 TO Q29",
   0.90, 0.84, 0.12, "q2", "Q10 TO Q19",
   0.90, 0.84, -0.12, "q1", "UNDER Q10"
) #593722FF, #834D24FF, #AB5D26FF, #C3722AFF, #E1C473FF, #E6DAB9FF, #A4B591FF, #55804DFF, #416C39FF, #2C5724FF

# Data preparation
pie_reference <- ref %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genotype)) %>%
  transmute(barcode = sample,
            locus,
            ref_allele = substr(genotype, 1, 1), #separates genotype
            zygosity = ifelse(substr(genotype, 1, 1) == substr(genotype, 2, 2), "hom", "het")) # labels for genotypes

pie_reads <- read_tsv(asp_reads_path, col_select = c(barcode, locus, called_allele, snp_position_quality),
                      col_types = cols(barcode = "c", locus = "c", called_allele = "c", snp_position_quality = "d")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(called_allele)) %>% # counted reads only
  inner_join(pie_reference, by = c("barcode", "locus")) %>% # pairs with a ref genotype
  mutate(category = as.character(cut(snp_position_quality, c(-Inf, 9, 19, 29, Inf), #puts each one in a quality group
                                     labels = c("q1", "q2", "q3", "q4"))))

# The drawing function (same layout for both pies)
pie_draw <- function(reads, top_label, bottom_label, title, caption) { # It takes reads for one pie chart already labeled with top or bottom
  counts <- reads %>%
    count(half, category) %>% # Counts reads per half and quality category
    complete(half = c("top", "bottom"), category = pie_categories, fill = list(n = 0)) %>% # Adds missing combinations
    group_by(half) %>%
    mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n), half_n = sum(n)) %>% # Creates %
    ungroup()
print(kable(counts, digits = 1))

  slices <- counts %>%
    select(half, category, percent) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(half = c("top", "bottom"), category = "blank", percent = 60)) %>% # Creates two invisible blank slices
    mutate(slice = factor(paste(half, category, sep = "_"), levels = c("top_blank", paste0("top_", rev(pie_categories)),
                                                                       "bottom_blank", paste0("bottom_", rev(pie_categories))))) %>% 
    arrange(slice) %>%
    mutate(theta = 2 * pi * percent / sum(percent), # Eeach slice angle in radians
           final_theta = cumsum(theta) - first(theta) / 2, # Turns the pie back by half
           initial_theta = lag(final_theta, default = 0)) %>%
    filter(category != "blank", percent > 0) # Removes blanks

  # The outline of each slice: center, then along the arc, back to the center
  wedges <- slices %>%
      mutate(points = Map(function(from, to) {
      angles <- seq(from, to, length.out = 200) # Gives the function a starting and ending angle and 200 in between for a smooth arc
      tibble(x = c(0, cos(angles), 0), y = c(0, sin(angles), 0))
    }, initial_theta, final_theta)) %>%
    unnest(points)

  labels <- slices %>%
    mutate(mid = (initial_theta + final_theta) / 2,
           radius = ifelse(percent >= 10, 0.62, 0.86), # for small slices label is further out
           size = ifelse(percent >= 10, 11, 8),
           x = radius * cos(mid),
           y = radius * sin(mid),
           text = sprintf("%.0f%%", percent))

  n_top <- counts$half_n[counts$half == "top"][1]
  n_bottom <- counts$half_n[counts$half == "bottom"][1]

  ggplot(wedges, aes(x, y, group = slice, fill = category)) +
    geom_polygon(show.legend = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_text(data = labels, aes(x, y, label = text, size = size / .pt), inherit.aes = FALSE, family = plot_font) +
    geom_point(data = pie_legend, aes(x_dot, y, fill = category), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               shape = 21, size = 7, stroke = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = pie_legend, aes(x_label, y, label = label, hjust = ifelse(x_label < 0, 0, 1)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              family = plot_font, size = 6.5 / .pt) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = c(1.1, -1.1), family = plot_font, size = 8 / .pt,
             label = c(sprintf(top_label, format(n_top, big.mark = ",")),
                       sprintf(bottom_label, format(n_bottom, big.mark = ",")))) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pie_fills) +
    scale_size_identity() +
    labs(title = title, caption = caption, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20, b = 35)),
          plot.caption = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 6, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 30)),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(b = 30, l = 80, r = 80))
}


# 1. Pie plot for right vs wrong reads in HM pairs
pie_right_wrong_reads <- pie_reads %>%
  filter(zygosity == "hom", !is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(called_allele == ref_allele, "top", "bottom"))

pie_fig_right_wrong <- pie_draw(
  pie_right_wrong_reads,
  top_label = "CORRECTLY CALLED READS (%s).",
  bottom_label = "WRONGLY CALLED READS (%s).",
  title = "READ BASE QUALITY ON THE SNP.",
  caption = sprintf("%s DATASET; READS FROM SAMPLE-LOCUS PAIRS THAT ARE HOMOZYGOUS IN THE REFERENCE.", toupper(dataset_name)))

print(pie_fig_right_wrong)
ggsave(pie_out_right_wrong, pie_fig_right_wrong, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", pie_out_right_wrong), pie_fig_right_wrong, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)

# 2. Pie plot, reads of the rarer allele, HM (miscalls or noise) vs HT pairs
pie_rare_allele_reads <- pie_reads %>%
  add_count(barcode, locus, called_allele, name = "allele_n") %>%
  group_by(barcode, locus) %>%
  filter(called_allele != called_allele[which.max(allele_n)]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(zygosity == "hom", "top", "bottom"))

pie_fig_rare_allele <- pie_draw(
  pie_rare_allele_reads,
  top_label = "RARER ALLELE IN HOMOZYGOTES: ERRORS (%s READS).",
  bottom_label = "RARER ALLELE IN HETEROZYGOTES: REAL SECOND ALLELE (%s READS).",
  title = "THE RARER ALLELE READ BASE\nQUALITY ON THE SNP.",
  caption = sprintf("%s DATASET; RARER ALLELE = THE ALLELE FEWER READS CALL IN THAT SAMPLE AND LOCUS.", toupper(dataset_name)))

print(pie_fig_rare_allele)
ggsave(pie_out_rare_allele, pie_fig_rare_allele, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", pie_out_rare_allele), pie_fig_rare_allele, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)

# 3. Plot,Du Bois spiral (plate 25 style) for the big-dataset speed optimization. Each band one total pipeline time, lentgh proportional
spi_out_dir <- "Results/big/Graphics/Dubois_plots"
dir.create(spi_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# total pipeline time per version in seconds
stopifnot(exists("v1_naive_pipeline_total_big"), exists("v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big"),
          exists("v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big"), exists("v5_pipeline_total_big"),
          exists("v6_pipeline_total_big"))

spi_timings <- tribble(
  ~version, ~seconds,
  "NAIVE, NOT QUALITY AWARE (V1)*", v1_naive_pipeline_total_big,
  "QUALITY-AWARE (V2)", v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big,
  "RESTRUCTURED - 3 CORES (V4)", v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big,
  "DIRECTION-AWARE - 7 CORES (V5)", v5_pipeline_total_big,
  "FINAL - 5 CORES (V11)", v6_pipeline_total_big) %>%
  arrange(seconds) 

# centre number: quality-aware V2 time/final time (V1 not counted)
spi_speedup <- v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big / v6_pipeline_total_big

spi_fills <- setNames(c("#2C5724FF", "#72874EFF", "#E6DAB9FF", "#E1C473FF", "#AB5D26FF"), spi_timings$version)
 #593722FF, #834D24FF, #AB5D26FF, #C3722AFF, #E1C473FF, #E6DAB9FF, #A4B591FF, #55804DFF, #416C39FF, #2C5724FF

spi_start_radius <- 15
spi_end_radius <- 9
spi_thickness <- 0.6
spi_min_length <- 0.35 # the smallest band would be almost invisible, minimum lentgth

# One row per version, position and label
spi_bands <- spi_timings %>%
  mutate(fraction = seconds / max(seconds), # the slowest version = 1 = the whole spiral
         offset = spi_thickness * (row_number() - 1), # each band sits one thickness further in
         label_y = spi_start_radius - offset - spi_thickness / 2, 
         time_label = case_when(seconds >= 3600 ~ sprintf("%.1f HOURS", seconds / 3600),
                                seconds >= 60 ~ sprintf("%.1f MIN", seconds / 60),
                                TRUE ~ sprintf("%.0f SEC", seconds)),
         version = factor(version, levels = version))

# Spiral bands as polygons. Points along one spiral line, from the top (angle 9*pi/2) round to the lower left (angle 3*pi/4), with length = the distance travelled along the line so far
spi_spiral_line <- function(from_radius, to_radius) {
  radius <- seq(from_radius, to_radius, length.out = 2000)
  angle <- seq(9 * pi / 2, 3 * pi / 4, length.out = 2000)
  x <- radius * cos(angle)
  y <- radius * sin(angle)
  tibble(x = x, y = y, length = cumsum(c(0, sqrt(diff(x)^2 + diff(y)^2))))
}

# the full length of the outer edge of thevinnermost band (100 %)
spi_full_length <- with(tail(spi_bands, 1),
                        max(spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset, spi_end_radius - offset)$length))

# each band = its outer edge, cut to its share of the full length, then back along its inner edge
spi_polygons <- spi_bands %>%
  group_by(version) %>%
  reframe({
    outer <- spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset, spi_end_radius - offset)
    inner <- spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset - spi_thickness, spi_end_radius - offset - spi_thickness)
    keep <- outer$length <= max(fraction * spi_full_length, spi_min_length)
    tibble(x = c(outer$x[keep], rev(inner$x[keep])),
           y = c(outer$y[keep], rev(inner$y[keep])))
  })

# Plot
spi_fig <- ggplot(spi_polygons, aes(x, y, group = version, fill = version)) +
  geom_polygon(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = spi_bands, aes(x = -0.5, y = label_y, label = time_label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = plot_font, size = 6.5 / .pt, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(data = spi_bands, aes(x = -9.2, y = label_y, label = version), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = plot_font, size = 6 / .pt, hjust = 1) +
  annotate("segment", x = -9, xend = -5.2, y = spi_bands$label_y, yend = spi_bands$label_y, linewidth = 0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.6, label = sprintf("%.0fx", spi_speedup), family = plot_font, size = 25 / .pt) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -2.0, label = "FASTER", family = plot_font, size = 9 / .pt) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spi_fills) +
  labs(title = "TOTAL PIPELINE TIME OF THE ASP GENOTYPER\nON THE BIG DATASET, BY VERSION.",
       caption = "* THE NAIVE VERSION DOES LESS WORK PER READ; NOT A DIRECT COMPARISON.\nCENTRE: QUALITY-AWARE (V2) TIME / FINAL TIME.",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20, b = 40)),
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 6, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 30)),
        plot.margin = margin(b = 40, l = 130, r = 30))

print(spi_fig)
ggsave(file.path(spi_out_dir, "spiral_figure.png"), spi_fig, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(spi_out_dir, "spiral_figure.pdf"), spi_fig, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
```



## BICF2G630340139 - Problematic locus analysis and diagnosis 
Analysis and diagnosis of why this BICF2G630340139 locus fails at 13 different pairs and wrognly calls the HT genotpyes, where there should have been HM. A lot of correct T reads get removed by the position agreement rule because of primer hopping on T reads. T primer fits perfectly, but C primer hops depending on the SNP base read position quality. When quality is low it accepts a mismatch at SNP position and T primer correctly wins, but at higher SNP qualities the mismatch cost more, because higher qualities should be trusted more, when they mismatch they are penalized even more, that's the overall rule with pairwiseAlignment function. At higher qualities its better for the C primer to take the gap penalty (first unchanged 8), which costs less and the SNP position changes to next base which is luckily C, so it only counts one gap penalty. T primer still wins, with high score margin, but position agreement rule cuts it out of voting, correctly. But the the problem is systematic and its purely settings based. Options for fixing this problem: make the indel gap penalty cost more (9), which works but this option also loses a lot more reads, which were correct but previously stayed just above the 0.65 threshold line. Changing the preassigned primer quality from 22L to 18L, which lowers the mismatch cost, theoretically lowers the ceilings of the highest possible mismatch penalty at higher qualities. The jist of both fixes is, if the gap penalty has to cost more than the mismatch penalty. Removing the anchor from just this one read doesn't work, one could also try adding a relative margin filter in tandem with position agreement rule, since nearly all the T reads that get removed are high quality T reads.

```{r Problematic_Locus_Hop_DataPrep, eval = params$run_speedopt_diagnosis, results = "asis"}
# Diagnosis analysis and plots for this problematic locus BICF2G630340139:
# Plot 1 (T read): why the C primer hops on a high-quality T read (the rule removes it)
# Plot 2 (C read): why the T primer never hops on a C read (the rule keeps it)
# Plot 3: % of T reads the rule removes under 7 different primer-quality/gap settings

stopifnot("run the setup chunk first (asp_functions.R)" = exists("score_reads_against_primers_2pwalign_v8") && exists("build_match_lookup"))

# Output path
hop_out_dir <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Problematic_Locus_Diagnosis")
dir.create(hop_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Settings for the original problem, reweritten here manually for visualization
# settings of the ORIGINAL problem (hop_ prefix, so they don't overwrite your current settings from setup)
hop_fastq_dir <- file.path("Data/Processed_data", dataset_name, "Demultiplexed_sequence_data/Identified_padded_sample_sequences")
hop_fastq_regex <- "_padded\\.fastq$"
hop_locus <- "BICF2G630340139"
hop_allele1 <- "T"
hop_allele2 <- "C"
hop_asp1 <- "CCTTCTTCCATATGCTAGGTGCTTT"
hop_asp2 <- "CCTTCTTCCATATGCTAGGTGCTTC"
hop_anchor <- "CCC" 
hop_primer_quality <- 22L
hop_gap_opening <- 6
hop_gap_extension <- 2
hop_gap_cost <- hop_gap_opening + hop_gap_extension # price of an indel
hop_Q_low <- 10 
hop_Q_high <- 35
hop_min_score_fraction <- 0.65 
hop_q_cap <- 48 # plot 3: qualities above this are pooled
hop_min_reads <- 5 # plot 3: qualities with fewer T reads are not drawn
hop_snp_in_read <- 10 + nchar(hop_asp1) # read position of the allele base in the example reads
hop_window <- (hop_snp_in_read - 8):(hop_snp_in_read + 6) # read positions drawn in panel A

# 3. Plot, the 7 settings to compare in one line each
gap_grid <- tribble(
  ~label, ~gap_opening, ~primer_quality,
  "Q23, gap 8", 6, 23L,
  "Q22, gap 8 (original)", 6, 22L,
  "Q21, gap 8", 6, 21L,
  "Q20, gap 8", 6, 20L,
  "Q19, gap 8 (current)", 6, 19L,
  "Q18, gap 8", 6, 18L,
  "Q22, gap 9", 7, 22L)

# Colours
gap_style <- list(fills = c(read = "#e8e4dc", match = "#D3D8C5", mismatch = "#D99A85", gap = "#E1C473"),
                  ink = "#222222", red = error_colour, blue = "#476F84", gold = "#c9962a", grey = "grey45",
                  bg = "white",
                  settings = rev(c("#3D5941FF", "#778868FF", "#B5B991FF", "#F6EDBDFF", "#EDBB8AFF", "#DE8A5AFF", "#CA562CFF")))

# Plots theme
gap_theme_plot <- theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.background = element_rect(fill = gap_style$bg, colour = NA))
gap_theme_tiles <- theme_void(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 9) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = gap_style$bg, colour = NA), plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))

# Reads for the problematic locus from every .fastq file
problem_locus_files <- list.files(hop_fastq_dir, pattern = hop_fastq_regex, full.names = TRUE)

# Parsing of the .fastq files
one_read_parsing_f <- function(fastq_file) {
  fastq_lines <- readLines(fastq_file)
  headers <- fastq_lines[seq(1, length(fastq_lines), by = 4)]
  is_locus <- grepl(paste0('"experiment":"', hop_locus, '"'), headers, fixed = TRUE) 
  tibble(direction = sub('.*"obimultiplex_direction":"([^"]*)".*', "\\1", headers[is_locus]),
         seq = fastq_lines[seq(2, length(fastq_lines), by = 4)][is_locus],
         qual = fastq_lines[seq(4, length(fastq_lines), by = 4)][is_locus])
}

problem_locus_reads <- bind_rows(lapply(problem_locus_files, one_read_parsing_f))
problem_locus_set <- DNAStringSet(problem_locus_reads$seq) # built once, used by every setting

# Scoring the reads
one_setting_scoring_f <- function(k) {
  setting <- gap_grid[k, ]
  result <- score_reads_against_primers_2pwalign_v8(problem_locus_set, problem_locus_reads$qual, problem_locus_reads$direction,
    hop_asp1, hop_asp2, hop_allele1, hop_allele2, hop_min_score_fraction,
    match_lookup = build_match_lookup(setting$primer_quality), primer_quality = setting$primer_quality, gap_opening = setting$gap_opening,
    gap_extension = hop_gap_extension, anchor = hop_anchor,
    input_type = "padded", # padded reads keep their orientation, so reverse reads need the rc primers
    threshold_type = "fraction") # the original min_score_fraction rule

  tibble(label = setting$label,
         called_allele_raw = result$called_allele_raw,
         snp_position_quality = result$snp_position_quality,
         snp_position_disagree = result$snp_position_disagree)
}

gap_scoring_results <- mclapply(seq_len(nrow(gap_grid)), one_setting_scoring_f, mc.cores = n_cores)
gap_failed <- vapply(gap_scoring_results, inherits, logical(1), "try-error") # a worker that crashed returns an error object instead of a tibble
if (any(gap_failed)) stop("scoring failed for ", sum(gap_failed), " settings, first error: ", gap_scoring_results[[which(gap_failed)[1]]])

all_reads_scores <- bind_rows(gap_scoring_results) %>%
  filter(!is.na(called_allele_raw), !is.na(snp_position_quality)) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = gap_grid$label))

# Data prep
# Two example reads
hop_read_T <- paste0("ACGTAGGCTA", substr(hop_asp1, 1, nchar(hop_asp1) - 1), hop_allele1, "CCCC", "AGTCGTG")
hop_read_C <- paste0("ACGTAGGCTA", substr(hop_asp1, 1, nchar(hop_asp1) - 1), hop_allele2, "CCCC", "AGTCGTG")

# Aligns one read to the primer and returns aligned read and prienr with "-" for gaps, the starting position and score
align_one_read_f <- function(read, primer, Q, gap_open = hop_gap_opening) {
  a <- pairwiseAlignment(DNAString(read), DNAString(paste0(primer, hop_anchor)), type = "local-global",
                                  patternQuality = PhredQuality(strrep(intToUtf8(Q + 33), nchar(read))),
                                  subjectQuality = PhredQuality(intToUtf8(hop_primer_quality + 33)),
                                  gapOpening = gap_open, gapExtension = hop_gap_extension)

  list(read = as.character(pattern(a)), primer = as.character(subject(a)),
       start = start(pattern(a)), score = score(a))
}

# One tile per read base, turns one alignemnt into a table with one row per base
alignment_tiles_f <- function(al, primer_len, row) {
  r <- strsplit(al$read, "")[[1]]
  p <- strsplit(al$primer, "")[[1]]
  tibble(x = al$start - 1 + cumsum(r != "-"), base = p, read_base = r,
         primer_pos = ifelse(p == "-", NA, cumsum(p != "-")), row = row) %>%
    filter(r != "-") %>% # # filtering for no gaps
    mutate(status = case_when(base == "-" ~ "gap", base == read_base ~ "match", TRUE ~ "mismatch"),
           is_snp = !is.na(primer_pos) & primer_pos == primer_len)
}

# Points lsot by base quality
hop_match_lookup <- build_match_lookup(hop_primer_quality)
score_price_comparison <- tibble(Q = 0:45) %>%
  mutate(match = hop_match_lookup[Q + 1], 
         mismatch_option = vapply(Q, mismatch_cost_f, numeric(1), hop_primer_quality), # base mismatch
         hop_C_read = match + hop_gap_cost) #

lowest_Q_to_hop <- score_price_comparison$Q[which(score_price_comparison$mismatch_option > hop_gap_cost)[1]]

# Panel C: reads removed by the rule per SNP-quality group, at the plots setting
quality_labels <- c("<10", "10-14", "15-19", "20-22", "23-25", "26-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40+")
all_reads_scores_removed <- all_reads_scores %>%
  filter(label == gap_grid$label[gap_grid$primer_quality == hop_primer_quality & gap_grid$gap_opening == hop_gap_opening][1]) %>%
  mutate(quality_bin = cut(snp_position_quality, c(-Inf, 9, 14, 19, 22, 25, 29, 34, 39, Inf), labels = quality_labels)) %>%
  group_by(called_allele_raw, quality_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), removed = 100 * mean(snp_position_disagree), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(xpos = as.integer(quality_bin))
kable(all_reads_scores_removed, digits = 1)

# panel C base, shared by plots 1 and 2
hop_last_pts <- slice_tail(all_reads_scores_removed, n = 1, by = called_allele_raw) # last point of each line, for the line labels
hop_panel_C <- ggplot(all_reads_scores_removed, aes(xpos, removed, colour = called_allele_raw, group = called_allele_raw)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(data = hop_last_pts, aes(label = paste(called_allele_raw, "reads")), hjust = -0.25, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(quality_labels), labels = quality_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(subtitle = sprintf("%s: reads removed by the position disagreement rule by SNP base quality", hop_locus),
       x = "Phred quality of the SNP", y = "% of reads removed") +
  gap_theme_plot +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 30, 5, 5))

# Plot 1: T read when C primer hops, it runs in local because the variables are shared, otherwise every single variable would need a different name
plot_T_read <- local({
  st <- gap_style
  win <- hop_window
  read <- hop_read_T

  al_T <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp1, hop_Q_high)
  al_C_low <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp2, hop_Q_low)
  al_C_high <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp2, hop_Q_high)
  C_high_mismatch_score <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp2, hop_Q_high, gap_open = 1000)$score # option not taken
  C_low_gap_score <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp1, hop_Q_low)$score - hop_gap_cost # option not taken

  rows <- c("Read (T allele)", "T primer + anchor", sprintf("C primer + anchor, SNP at Q%d", hop_Q_low),
            sprintf("C primer + anchor, SNP at Q%d", hop_Q_high))
  tiles <- bind_rows(tibble(x = seq_len(nchar(read)), base = strsplit(read, "")[[1]], row = rows[1], status = "read", is_snp = x == hop_snp_in_read),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_T, nchar(hop_asp1), rows[2]),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_C_low, nchar(hop_asp2), rows[3]),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_C_high, nchar(hop_asp2), rows[4])) %>%
    mutate(y = match(row, rev(rows))) %>%
    filter(x %in% win)
  snp_at <- setNames(tiles$x[tiles$is_snp], tiles$row[tiles$is_snp])
  if (snp_at[[rows[4]]] == snp_at[[rows[2]]])
    warning("figure 1: the Q", hop_Q_high, " C-primer alignment did not hop with these settings")

  notes <- c("Two TT before the SNP position (T)",
             "Perfect fit",
             sprintf("Opt1: mismatch (%.1f) costs less than a gap (%.1f)", al_C_low$score, C_low_gap_score),
             sprintf("Opt2: gap (%.1f) costs less than a mismatch (%.1f)\nSNP position disagreement -> read removed",
                     al_C_high$score, C_high_mismatch_score))

  pA <- ggplot(tiles, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = status), width = 0.92, height = 0.62, colour = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(tiles, is_snp), width = 0.92, height = 0.62, fill = NA, colour = st$ink, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = base), family = "mono", fontface = "bold", size = 4.2, colour = st$ink) +
    annotate("text", x = min(win) - 0.8, y = 4:1, label = rows, hjust = 1, size = 3, colour = st$ink) +
    annotate("text", x = max(win) + 0.8, y = 4:1, label = notes, hjust = 0, size = 2.7,
             colour = c(st$grey, st$grey, st$grey, st$red), lineheight = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = win, y = 4.45, label = win, size = 2.2, colour = st$grey) +
    annotate("text", x = max(win) - 3.5, y = 0.35, size = 2.6, colour = st$grey, label = "Boxed = aligned SNP position") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = st$fills, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(win) - 9, max(win) + 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.2, 4.6)) +
    labs(title = "A On a T read C primer has two ways to align a read, on higher quality reads it takes the one with a gap",
         subtitle = sprintf("Real primers and %s anchor; read positions on top. Gap = %g + %g = %g points.",
                            hop_anchor, hop_gap_opening, hop_gap_extension, hop_gap_cost)) +
    gap_theme_tiles

  pB <- ggplot(filter(score_price_comparison, Q >= 3), aes(Q, mismatch_option)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = lowest_Q_to_hop, xmax = 45, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = st$red, alpha = 0.07) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = hop_gap_cost, colour = st$gold, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(colour = st$ink, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = lowest_Q_to_hop, linetype = 2, colour = st$red) +
    annotate("text", x = 4, y = hop_gap_cost + 0.35, label = sprintf("Gap penalty = %g", hop_gap_cost),
             hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = "#9a7118") +
    annotate("text", x = 44, y = max(score_price_comparison$mismatch_option) - 0.6, label = "mismatch at the SNP", hjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
    annotate("text", x = lowest_Q_to_hop + 0.8, y = 2, label = sprintf("from Q%d the gap is cheaper\n-> the C primer hops", lowest_Q_to_hop),
             hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = st$red, lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 45, 10)) +
    labs(title = "B  Which option is cheaper depends on read quality",
         subtitle = "Points lost by the C primer: mismatch option vs gap option",
         x = "Phred quality of the read bases",
         y = "Points lost") +
    gap_theme_plot

  pC <- hop_panel_C +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 4.5, xmax = 9.6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = st$red, alpha = 0.07) + # quality range where the C primer hops
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c(st$red, st$blue), c(hop_allele1, hop_allele2)), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = sprintf("C  Systematic error on the %s dataset", dataset_name))

  wrap_plots(pA, wrap_plots(pB, pC), ncol = 1, heights = c(1.1, 1)) &
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = st$bg, colour = NA))
})


# Plot 2: C read, primer never hops
plot_C_read <- local({
  st <- gap_style
  snp <- hop_snp_in_read
  win <- hop_window
  read <- hop_read_C
  read_T <- hop_read_T
  n <- nchar(hop_asp1)

  al_C <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp2, hop_Q_high)
  al_T_low <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp1, hop_Q_low)
  al_T_high <- align_one_read_f(read, hop_asp1, hop_Q_high)
  # score of the hop the T primer would need: perfect fit, minus the match of the unpaired base, minus the gap
  hop_option_score <- function(Q) align_one_read_f(read_T, hop_asp1, Q)$score - hop_match_lookup[Q + 1] - hop_gap_cost

  hop_tiles <- tibble(x = c((snp - n + 1):(snp - 3), NA, snp - 2, snp - 1, snp + 0:2),
                      base = strsplit(paste0(hop_asp1, hop_anchor), "")[[1]],
                      primer_pos = seq_len(n + nchar(hop_anchor)))
  unpaired <- tibble(x = snp - 2.5,
                     y = 1.52,
                     base = hop_tiles$base[is.na(hop_tiles$x)])

  rows <- c("Read (C allele)", "C primer + anchor", sprintf("T primer + anchor, SNP at Q%d", hop_Q_low),
            sprintf("T primer + anchor, SNP at Q%d", hop_Q_high), "The hop the T primer would need")
  read_bases <- strsplit(read, "")[[1]]
  tiles <- bind_rows(tibble(x = seq_len(nchar(read)), base = strsplit(read, "")[[1]], row = rows[1], status = "read", is_snp = x == hop_snp_in_read),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_C, nchar(hop_asp2), rows[2]),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_T_low, n, rows[3]),
                     alignment_tiles_f(al_T_high, n, rows[4]),
                     hop_tiles %>% filter(!is.na(x)) %>%
                       mutate(read_base = read_bases[x], row = rows[5],
                              status = ifelse(base == read_base, "match", "mismatch"),
                              is_snp = primer_pos == n)) %>%
    mutate(y = match(row, rev(rows))) %>%
    filter(x %in% win)
  snp_at <- setNames(tiles$x[tiles$is_snp], tiles$row[tiles$is_snp])
  if (any(snp_at[rows[2:4]] != snp)) warning("figure 2: a real alignment hopped with these settings")

  notes <- c("Two TT before the SNP position",
             "Perfect fit",
             sprintf("Opt1: mismatch (%.1f) costs less than a gap (%.1f)", al_T_low$score, hop_option_score(hop_Q_low)),
             sprintf("Opt1: mismatch (%.1f) still costs less than a gap (%.1f)", al_T_high$score, hop_option_score(hop_Q_high)),
             "The hop is never chosen,\nbecause a gap plus a lost match always costs more")

  pA <- ggplot(tiles, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = status), width = 0.92, height = 0.62, colour = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(tiles, is_snp), width = 0.92, height = 0.62, fill = NA, colour = st$ink, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = base), family = "mono", fontface = "bold", size = 4.2, colour = st$ink) +
    geom_tile(data = unpaired, aes(x, y), width = 0.8, height = 0.34, fill = st$fills[["gap"]], inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = unpaired, aes(x, y, label = base), family = "mono", fontface = "bold", size = 3.2,
              colour = st$ink, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    annotate("segment", x = unpaired$x, xend = unpaired$x, y = unpaired$y - 0.17, yend = 1.31, colour = st$ink, linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = unpaired$x - 0.6, y = unpaired$y, label = "Gap", hjust = 1, size = 2.5, colour = "#9a7118") +
    annotate("segment", x = snp - 1, xend = snp, y = 0.58, yend = 0.58, colour = st$grey,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5, "mm"), ends = "both")) +
    annotate("text", x = min(win) - 0.8, y = 5:1, label = rows, hjust = 1, size = 3,
             colour = c(rep(st$ink, 4), st$grey)) +
    annotate("text", x = max(win) + 0.8, y = 5:1, label = notes, hjust = 0, size = 2.7,
             colour = c(st$grey, st$grey, st$blue, st$blue, st$grey), lineheight = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = win, y = 5.45, label = win, size = 2.2, colour = st$grey) +
    annotate("text", x = max(win) - 3.0, y = 0.2, size = 2.6, colour = st$grey, label = "Boxed = aligned SNP position") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = st$fills, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(win) - 9, max(win) + 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.05, 5.6)) +
    labs(title = "A  On a C read the T primer never hops: the hop would cost more than the mismatch it avoids",
         subtitle = sprintf("Real primers and %s anchor; read positions on top. Gap = %g + %g = %g points.",
                            hop_anchor, hop_gap_opening, hop_gap_extension, hop_gap_cost)) +
    gap_theme_tiles

  price_long <- score_price_comparison %>% filter(Q >= 3) %>%
    select(Q, `mismatch (option 1)` = mismatch_option, `hop: gap + lost match` = hop_C_read) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Q, names_to = "option", values_to = "lost")
  pB <- ggplot(price_long, aes(Q, lost, colour = option)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = hop_gap_cost, colour = "grey70", linetype = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = filter(price_long, Q == max(Q)), aes(label = option), hjust = 1, vjust = -0.8,
              size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = 4, y = hop_gap_cost - 0.35, hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = "grey50",
             label = sprintf("Gap penalty = %g", hop_gap_cost)) +
    annotate("text", x = 25, y = 3.2, hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = st$blue, lineheight = 0.9,
             label = "the hop is always the more expensive option") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`mismatch (option 1)` = st$ink, `hop: gap + lost match` = st$gold), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 45, 10)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(price_long$lost) + 1)) +
    labs(title = "B  The two lines never cross",
         subtitle = "Points the T primer loses on a C read, compared with a perfect fit",
         x = "Phred quality of the read bases", y = "points lost") +
    gap_theme_plot

  pC <- hop_panel_C +
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c("grey70", st$blue), c(hop_allele1, hop_allele2)), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = sprintf("C  The %s dataset: C reads stay hidden", dataset_name))

  wrap_plots(pA, wrap_plots(pB, pC), ncol = 1, heights = c(1.1, 1)) &
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = st$bg, colour = NA))
})


# Plot 3: Percentage of T reads removed by different settings for primery Q and indels penalties
plot_setting_comparison <- local({
  st <- gap_style
  T_reads <- filter(all_reads_scores, called_allele_raw == hop_allele1)

  # legend labels per setting
  totals <- T_reads %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    summarise(pct_removed = 100 * mean(snp_position_disagree), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(legend = paste0(label, ": ", sprintf("%.1f", pct_removed), " % removed"))
print(kable(totals, digits = 1))

  # % of T reads removed per setting and per SNP quality (qualities above the cap pooled)
  removed_by_quality <- T_reads %>%
    mutate(q = pmin(snp_position_quality, hop_q_cap)) %>%
    group_by(label, q) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), removed = 100 * mean(snp_position_disagree), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n >= hop_min_reads) %>%
    left_join(select(totals, label, legend), by = "label") %>%
    mutate(legend = factor(legend, levels = totals$legend))

  x_breaks <- seq(0, hop_q_cap, by = 4)
  x_labels <- ifelse(x_breaks == hop_q_cap, paste0(hop_q_cap, "+"), x_breaks)

  ggplot(removed_by_quality, aes(q, removed, colour = legend, linetype = legend, group = legend)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(st$settings, totals$legend), name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c(rep("solid", 6), "22"), totals$legend), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(title = "Lowering the preassigned primer quality stops the rule from removing good T reads",
         subtitle = sprintf("%s, %s dataset: %% of T reads removed by the position-agreement rule", hop_locus, dataset_name),
         x = "Phred quality of the SNP",
         y = "% of T reads removed") +
    gap_theme_plot +
    theme(legend.position = "inside",
          legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.52),
          legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.key.width = unit(2, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 5))
})
```

## Demultiplxeing and filtration process visualized - Sankey, Upset, Barplot 

```{r Demultiplexing_and_Filtration_Process_Visualized, eval = params$run_filtration_vis, fig.width = 11.69, fig.height = 8.27, out.width = "100%"}
# Input and output paths
out_dir_sankey <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Demultiplexing_and_Filtration_Visualization")
dir.create(out_dir_sankey, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
raw_basecalled_dir <- file.path("Data/Raw_data", dataset_name) # Raw reads
counts_cache_file <- file.path(out_dir_sankey, "fastq_read_counts_all.rds") # cache for fastq counts
demultiplexed_dir <- file.path("Data/Processed_data", dataset_name, "Demultiplexed_sequence_data")
dorado_dir <- file.path(demultiplexed_dir, "Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample") 
obi_identified_dir <- file.path(demultiplexed_dir, "Identified_sample_sequences_Obi4") 
obi_unidentified_dir <- file.path(demultiplexed_dir, "Unidentified_sample_sequences_Obi4")

dorado_file_pattern <- "^(barcode\\d+|unclassified)\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$"
recount_fastq <- FALSE # TRUE = counts the fastq files again

stopifnot("run the setup chunk first, panel is needed for the homopolymers" = exists("panel"))

# Reading the fastq files and returns read ID for each and position. Used for IDs in Obimultiplexing and further for Sankey and amplicon assosication
fastq_read_ids <- function(path) {
  fastq_lines <- readLines(path) 
  sub(" .*$", "", substring(fastq_lines[seq(1, length(fastq_lines), by = 4)], 2))
}

# counts how many reads in the fastq files, returns a table with one row per read. Its used for Raw basecalled reads and Dorado files
count_fastq_records <- function(dir, pattern = "\\.(fastq|fq)(\\.gz)?$") {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)
  tibble(file = basename(files),
         records = vapply(files, function(f) length(fastq_read_ids(f)), numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE))
}

# Counts amplicons from ObiTools4 per file and checks where they come from
count_obi_amplicons <- function(dir, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)
  parent_reads <- lapply(files, function(f) sub("_sub.*$", "", fastq_read_ids(f))) 
  bind_rows(tibble(file = basename(files),
                   original_read = vapply(parent_reads, function(p) length(unique(p)), numeric(1)),
                   amplicons = vapply(parent_reads, length, numeric(1))),
            tibble(file = "TOTAL", original_read = length(unique(unlist(parent_reads))), amplicons = sum(lengths(parent_reads))))
}

# This part processes the reads based based on TRUE or false and if the RDS file exist. It takes quite elong so its better if you just cache it after first count
fastq_counts <- if (file.exists(counts_cache_file) && !recount_fastq) readRDS(counts_cache_file) else { # cached counts or count now
  new_counts <- list(raw = count_fastq_records(raw_basecalled_dir),
                     dorado = count_fastq_records(dorado_dir, dorado_file_pattern) %>%
                       mutate(barcode = sub(dorado_file_pattern, "\\1", file)), 
                     obi = count_obi_amplicons(obi_identified_dir, "_identified\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$"),
                     obi_unidentified = count_obi_amplicons(obi_unidentified_dir, "_unidentified\\.fastq(\\.gz)?$"))
  saveRDS(new_counts, counts_cache_file)
  new_counts
}

dorado_counts <- fastq_counts$dorado
obi_counts <- fastq_counts$obi

# Short summary of the reads.
dorado_summary <- dorado_counts %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(barcode == "unclassified", "Unclassified (no barcode)", "Assigned to a barcode")) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(reads = sum(records), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * reads / sum(reads), 2))
cat(sprintf("Raw basecalled reads: %s\n", comma(sum(fastq_counts$raw$records))))
kable(bind_rows(dorado_summary, tibble(class = "All passed reads", reads = sum(dorado_summary$reads), percent = 100)))
kable(select(dorado_counts, barcode, records))
kable(obi_counts)
kable(fastq_counts$obi_unidentified)

# Label setup for Sankey plot, names for outcome of reads 
label_primer_match <- "Primer match found" # step1 raw call
label_poor_alignment <- "Poor alignment" # step 1 below score threshold
label_tie <- "No allele signal" # step 1 both primers scored the same
sankey_used_label <- "Used for genotyping" # step 2, called
flag_labels <- c(snp_low_quality = "Low-quality SNP base", #filters
                      snp_position_disagree = "Position disagreement rule",
                      snp_missing = "SNP base missing",
                      too_many_mismatches = "Too many mismatches",
                      snp_mismatch_flag = "SNP base contradicts call")
label_several <- "Several problems" # failed more than one SNP check
label_flagging <- "Flagging filters" # for a bar plot where all filters are merged for clearer results
label_low_quality <- flag_labels[["snp_low_quality"]]

# Reads table, gives each read three new columns based on the final outcome per read
final_reads <- read_tsv(asp_reads_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(called_allele = "c", called_allele_raw = "c")) %>%
  mutate(failed_checks = rowSums(pick(all_of(names(flag_labels)))), # how many SNP checks a read failed
         step1 = case_when(tie_flag ~ label_tie, below_threshold_flag ~ label_poor_alignment, TRUE ~ label_primer_match),
         fate = case_when(tie_flag ~ label_tie,
                          below_threshold_flag ~ label_poor_alignment,
                          !is.na(called_allele) ~ sankey_used_label,
                          failed_checks >= 2 ~ label_several,
                          snp_low_quality ~ flag_labels[["snp_low_quality"]],
                          snp_position_disagree ~ flag_labels[["snp_position_disagree"]],
                          snp_missing ~ flag_labels[["snp_missing"]],
                          too_many_mismatches ~ flag_labels[["too_many_mismatches"]],
                          snp_mismatch_flag ~ flag_labels[["snp_mismatch_flag"]]),
         short = ifelse(fate %in% c(sankey_used_label, label_low_quality, label_tie, label_poor_alignment), fate, label_flagging)) 
stopifnot(all(c("winning_indel_events", "winning_nmismatch", "read_id", "locus", "barcode") %in% names(final_reads)), # short version for the barplot
          !any(is.na(final_reads$fate)))


# Colours
outcome_order <- c(sankey_used_label, unname(flag_labels), label_several, label_tie, label_poor_alignment)
outcome_colours <- setNames(c(correct_colour, # passed reads
                           "#D9B44A", # Low-quality SNP base
                           "#7F919B", # position disagreement rule
                           "#A8939E", # SNP base missing
                           "#56666B", # Too many mismatches
                           "#93A797", # SNP base contradicts call
                           "#A8957C", # several problems
                           "#A6453A", # No allele signal
                           "#C97B3D"), # Poor alignment
                         outcome_order)

# bar plot categories (left to right) and colours
bar_order <- c(sankey_used_label, label_low_quality, label_flagging, label_tie, label_poor_alignment)
bar_colours <- setNames(c(outcome_colours[[sankey_used_label]], outcome_colours[[label_low_quality]], outcome_colours[["Position disagreement rule"]],
                          outcome_colours[[label_tie]], outcome_colours[[label_poor_alignment]]), bar_order)

sankey_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#52514e"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

#First plot is Sankey
# front counts (original reads)
basecalled_reads <- sum(dorado_counts$records) # sum of Dorado files
no_barcode_reads <- sum(dorado_counts$records[dorado_counts$barcode == "unclassified"]) # Sum of Dorado unclassififed
assigned_reads <- basecalled_reads - no_barcode_reads #reads assigned to a sample
amplicon_found_reads <- n_distinct(sub("_sub.*$", "", final_reads$read_id))
no_amplicon_reads <- assigned_reads - amplicon_found_reads # no amplicons found

# Used for the middle fanned look in Sankey. amplicons per read, from the reads table (amplicons of one nanopore read share its id). Each group becomes one strand in the fan
amplicons_per_read <- final_reads %>%
  mutate(read_sharedid = sub("_sub.*$", "", read_id)) %>%
  count(read_sharedid, name = "amplicons_in_read") %>%
mutate(amplicon_group = pmin(amplicons_in_read, 13)) %>% # controls how many fans are there (poossible also  >= 8 so its not that crammed)
  group_by(amplicon_group) %>%
  summarise(reads = n(), amplicons = sum(amplicons_in_read), .groups = "drop")

# counts (amplicons)
total_amplicons <- nrow(final_reads)
sankey_pass_label <- "Passes all SNP checks"
sankey_not_used_label <- "Not used"
step1_nodes <- c(label_primer_match, label_poor_alignment, label_tie)
reject_nodes <- intersect(c(unname(flag_labels), label_several), unique(final_reads$fate))
step1_counts <- setNames(as.numeric(table(final_reads$step1)[step1_nodes]), step1_nodes) #number of amplicons in step 1
reject_counts <- setNames(as.numeric(table(final_reads$fate)[reject_nodes]), reject_nodes) # amplicon per snp check for step 2
used_count <- sum(final_reads$fate == sankey_used_label) # two outcome bars
not_used_count <- total_amplicons - used_count

# every column must add up (guards the percentages printed on the figure)
stopifnot(amplicon_found_reads <= assigned_reads, # an ObiTools run can't find amplicons in more reads than Dorado assigned
          assigned_reads + no_barcode_reads == basecalled_reads,
          no_amplicon_reads >= 0,
          sum(amplicons_per_read$amplicons) == total_amplicons,
          sum(step1_counts) == total_amplicons,
          used_count + sum(reject_counts) == step1_counts[[label_primer_match]],
          used_count + not_used_count == total_amplicons)

# Layout settings
node_gap <- 0.05 * total_amplicons # vertical gap between nodes (in reads)
node_width <- 0.04 # node width (x units)
sankey_column_x <- c(0, 1.15, 2.3, 3.55, 4.6, 5.65, 7.0) # column positions

# colours: one green for everything that continues or is used
correct_colour_nodes <- c("Basecalled reads", "Assigned to a sample", "Amplicon found", "Amplicons",
                      label_primer_match, sankey_pass_label, sankey_used_label)
sankey_strand_colours <- setNames(rep(correct_colour, nrow(amplicons_per_read)), paste0("strand_", amplicons_per_read$amplicon_group)) # fan strands
sankey_all_colours <- c(outcome_colours[setdiff(names(outcome_colours), correct_colour_nodes)], #gives every bar and strand its colour
                      setNames(rep(correct_colour, length(correct_colour_nodes)), correct_colour_nodes),
                      "No barcode" = "#B98B7E", 
                      "No amplicon found" = "#D9A877", 
                      setNames("#C9946A", sankey_not_used_label), 
                      sankey_strand_colours)

# nodes or bars, places several bars into one column, centered on given y
sankey_stack_nodes_f <- function(names, n, x, centre) {
  total_height <- sum(n) + node_gap * (length(n) - 1)
  ymin <- centre - total_height / 2 + c(0, cumsum(n + node_gap)[-length(n)])
  tibble(node = names, x = x, n = n, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymin + n)
}

sankey_centre <- total_amplicons / 2

# Columns 4-6 amplicons, step 1 and step2. Its centred on the middle of the amplicon bar
col_amplicons <- tibble(node = "Amplicons", x = sankey_column_x[4], n = total_amplicons, ymin = 0, ymax = total_amplicons)
col_step1 <- sankey_stack_nodes_f(step1_nodes, step1_counts, sankey_column_x[5], sankey_centre)
col_step2 <- sankey_stack_nodes_f(c(sankey_pass_label, reject_nodes, label_poor_alignment, label_tie), # step 1 losses carried through (unlabelled)
                                  c(used_count, reject_counts, step1_counts[[label_poor_alignment]], step1_counts[[label_tie]]),
                                  sankey_column_x[6], sankey_centre)

# Obitools4 column 3: kept reads centred on the amplicon bar, so the fan opens symmetrically
col_obi <- sankey_stack_nodes_f(c("Amplicon found", "No amplicon found"), c(amplicon_found_reads, no_amplicon_reads), sankey_column_x[3],
                                sankey_centre + (no_amplicon_reads + node_gap) / 2)
# Dorado column2, "Assigned to a sample" starts level with "Amplicon found"
col_dorado <- sankey_stack_nodes_f(c("Assigned to a sample", "No barcode"), c(assigned_reads, no_barcode_reads), sankey_column_x[2],
                                   col_obi$ymin[1] + (assigned_reads + no_barcode_reads + node_gap) / 2)
# Column 1, all basecalled reads, starting level with "Assigned to a sample"
col_basecalled <- tibble(node = "Basecalled reads", x = sankey_column_x[1], n = basecalled_reads,
                         ymin = col_dorado$ymin[1], ymax = ymin + n)

# Outcome last column, "Used" level with "Passes all SNP checks", "Not used".
rejects_middle <- (min(col_step2$ymin[-1]) + max(col_step2$ymax)) / 2
col_outcome <- tibble(node = c(sankey_used_label, sankey_not_used_label), x = sankey_column_x[7], n = c(used_count, not_used_count),
                      ymin = c(col_step2$ymin[1], rejects_middle - not_used_count / 2), ymax = ymin + n)

sankey_nodes <- bind_rows(col_basecalled, col_dorado, col_obi, col_amplicons, col_step1, col_step2, col_outcome) %>% # full table of bars, left to right
  mutate(carried = x == sankey_column_x[6] & node %in% c(label_poor_alignment, label_tie),
         base = ifelse(x < sankey_column_x[4], basecalled_reads, total_amplicons), 
         pct = 100 * n / base,
         label = case_when(
           x %in% c(sankey_column_x[1], sankey_column_x[4]) ~ sprintf("%s\nn = %s", node, comma(n)), # start of each unit: counts
           x == sankey_column_x[7] ~ sprintf("%s\nn = %s (%.1f %%)", node, comma(n), pct), # outcome: counts and %
           x < sankey_column_x[4] ~ sprintf("%s\n%.1f %%", node, pct), # front: two lines (narrow columns)
           TRUE ~ sprintf("%s  %.1f %%", node, pct)))

# flows (ns = width at the source, nd = width at the destination, they differ only in the fan)
sankey_flows <- bind_rows( 
  tibble(src = "Basecalled reads", sx = sankey_column_x[1], dst = c("Assigned to a sample", "No barcode"), dx = sankey_column_x[2],
         ns = c(assigned_reads, no_barcode_reads)),
  tibble(src = "Assigned to a sample", sx = sankey_column_x[2], dst = c("Amplicon found", "No amplicon found"), dx = sankey_column_x[3],
         ns = c(amplicon_found_reads, no_amplicon_reads)),
  tibble(src = "Amplicon found", sx = sankey_column_x[3], dst = "Amplicons", dx = sankey_column_x[4],
         ns = amplicons_per_read$reads, nd = amplicons_per_read$amplicons, strand = names(sankey_strand_colours)), # the fan
  tibble(src = "Amplicons", sx = sankey_column_x[4], dst = step1_nodes, dx = sankey_column_x[5], ns = step1_counts),
  tibble(src = label_primer_match, sx = sankey_column_x[5], dst = c(sankey_pass_label, reject_nodes), dx = sankey_column_x[6],
         ns = c(used_count, reject_counts)),
  tibble(src = c(label_poor_alignment, label_tie), sx = sankey_column_x[5], dst = c(label_poor_alignment, label_tie),
         dx = sankey_column_x[6], ns = step1_counts[c(label_poor_alignment, label_tie)]),
  tibble(src = sankey_pass_label, sx = sankey_column_x[6], dst = sankey_used_label, dx = sankey_column_x[7], ns = used_count),
  tibble(src = c(reject_nodes, label_poor_alignment, label_tie), sx = sankey_column_x[6], dst = sankey_not_used_label,
         dx = sankey_column_x[7], ns = c(reject_counts, step1_counts[c(label_poor_alignment, label_tie)]))) %>%
  mutate(nd = ifelse(is.na(nd), ns, nd), flow_order = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(select(sankey_nodes, src = node, sx = x, sy = ymin), by = c("src", "sx")) %>%
  left_join(select(sankey_nodes, dst = node, dx = x, dy = ymin), by = c("dst", "dx")) %>%
  group_by(src, sx) %>% arrange(dy, flow_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>% mutate(s0 = sy + cumsum(ns) - ns) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(dst, dx) %>% arrange(sy, flow_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>% mutate(d0 = dy + cumsum(nd) - nd) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(flow = row_number(),
         colour_key = case_when(!is.na(strand) ~ strand, # fan strands
                                dx == sankey_column_x[7] | src == dst ~ src, 
                                TRUE ~ dst)) 

# every flow as one smooth band: top and bottom edge follow an S-curve from the source bar to the destination bar
curve_steps <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 80)
curve_shape <- (1 - cos(pi * curve_steps)) / 2 # smooth S-curve from 0 to 1
sankey_flow_shapes <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(sankey_flows)), function(i) {
  f <- sankey_flows[i, ]
  x <- f$sx + node_width + (f$dx - f$sx - node_width) * curve_steps
  top <- f$s0 + (f$d0 - f$s0) * curve_shape
  bottom <- (f$s0 + f$ns) + ((f$d0 + f$nd) - (f$s0 + f$ns)) * curve_shape
  tibble(flow = f$flow, fill = sankey_all_colours[[f$colour_key]], is_strand = !is.na(f$strand), x = c(x, rev(x)), y = c(top, rev(bottom)))
}))

sankey_strand_labels <- filter(sankey_flows, !is.na(strand)) %>% # amplicons per read, at the wide end of the fan
  mutate(y = d0 + nd / 2, label = sub("strand_", "", strand))

# column titles just above the top bar of each column
sankey_column_top <- function(x) min(sankey_nodes$ymin[sankey_nodes$x == x])
sankey_column_titles <- tibble(x = c(sankey_column_x[c(2, 3, 5, 6)] + node_width / 2, (sankey_column_x[3] + sankey_column_x[4] + 1) / 2 + 0.15),
                               y = sapply(sankey_column_x[c(2, 3, 5, 6, 4)], sankey_column_top) - node_gap * c(0.3, 1.6, 0.9, 0.3, 0.3), 
                               label = c("Dorado\nDemultiplexing", "ObiTools4\nDemultiplexing", "Step 1:\ndoes a primer match?",
                                         "Step 2: is the SNP base reliable?", "Amplicons\nper read"))

p_sankey <- ggplot() +
   geom_polygon(data = sankey_flow_shapes, aes(x, y, group = flow, fill = fill, colour = fill), alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3) + 
  geom_polygon(data = filter(sankey_flow_shapes, is_strand), aes(x, y, group = flow), fill = NA, colour = correct_colour, linewidth = 0.3) + # fan strands outlined
  geom_rect(data = sankey_nodes, aes(xmin = x, xmax = x + node_width, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = sankey_all_colours[node])) + # the bars
  geom_label(data = filter(sankey_nodes, !carried), aes(x = x + node_width + 0.02, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = label),
             hjust = 0, size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95, colour = "grey10", fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.2, label.r = unit(0.12, "lines")) + 
  geom_text(data = sankey_strand_labels, aes(x = sankey_column_x[4] - 0.03, y = y, label = label), hjust = 1, size = 2.6, colour = "#3b3a36") +
  geom_text(data = sankey_strand_labels, aes(x = sankey_column_x[4] - 0.03, y = y, label = label), hjust = 1, size = 2.3, colour = "#3b3a36") +
  geom_text(data = sankey_column_titles, aes(x, y, label = label), vjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 2.9, colour = "#3b3a36", lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.05, 7.95), clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Basecalling, dual demultiplexing and filtration process of raw sequencing reads/amplicons") +
  theme_void(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)), plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12))

print(p_sankey)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_sankey.png"), p_sankey, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_sankey.pdf"), p_sankey, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, device = cairo_pdf)


# 2. Plot, outcome of reads per locus and statisctics

# calucaltes homopolymers per locus, rle() and run rep() write each "attggggc" into 1 2 4 1
hp_run_lengths_f <- function(sequence) {
  runs <- rle(strsplit(sequence, "")[[1]])
  rep(runs$lengths, runs$lengths)
}

# per locus, the worst case over its two ASP primers (+ anchor, as the read sees it)
locus_homopolymers <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(panel)), function(i) {
  anchor <- toupper(ifelse(is.na(panel$anchor[i]), "", panel$anchor[i]))
  bind_rows(lapply(toupper(c(panel$asp1_seq[i], panel$asp2_seq[i])), function(asp) {
    snp <- nchar(asp) # position of the SNP base
    run_at <- hp_run_lengths_f(paste0(asp, anchor))
    tibble(locus = panel$locus[i], primer_len = snp,
           hp_len_3p = max(run_at[intersect(snp + (-1:1), seq_along(run_at))]),  # homopolymer at snp
           hp_len_primer = max(run_at[seq_len(min(snp + 1, length(run_at)))])) # longest run anywhere
  }))
})) %>%
  summarise(primer_len = max(primer_len), hp_len_3p = max(hp_len_3p), hp_len_primer = max(hp_len_primer), .by = locus)

# Data prep, per locus indels, mismatches, fate shares
# indels and mismatches are counted on raw-call reads only, on poor alignments the indel count is the failure
locus_summary <- final_reads %>%
  group_by(locus) %>%
  summarise(n_reads = n(),
            n_raw = sum(!is.na(called_allele_raw)),
            indel_raw = mean(winning_indel_events[!is.na(called_allele_raw)], na.rm = TRUE), 
            mm_raw = mean(winning_nmismatch[!is.na(called_allele_raw)], na.rm = TRUE), 
            used = mean(!is.na(called_allele)),
            poor = mean(below_threshold_flag),
            tie = mean(tie_flag),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(locus_homopolymers, by = "locus") %>%
  mutate(indel_per_base = indel_raw / primer_len)
stopifnot("loci in the reads table missing from panel" = !anyNA(locus_summary$primer_len))

kable(arrange(locus_summary, indel_raw) %>% select(locus, n_reads, indel_raw, mm_raw, used, poor, tie, primer_len), digits = 3,
      col.names = c("Locus", "Reads", "Indel rate", "Mismatch rate", "Used", "Poor alignment", "Tie", "Primer length"))
kable(count(filter(final_reads, !is.na(called_allele_raw)), winning_indel_events))# indels per passing read

# Statistic tests, Spearman correlations across loci (Holm-adjusted over all tests)
correlation_pairs <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y,
  "hp_len_3p", "indel_raw",
  "hp_len_primer", "indel_raw",
  "hp_len_primer", "indel_per_base",
  "primer_len", "indel_raw",
  "indel_raw", "used",
  "indel_raw", "poor",
  "mm_raw", "used",
  "hp_len_3p", "tie",
  "hp_len_primer", "tie",
  "hp_len_3p", "used",
  "hp_len_primer", "used")

correlations <- bind_rows(Map(function(x, y) {
  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(locus_summary[[x]], locus_summary[[y]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)) # ties: no exact p
  tibble(x = x, y = y, n = sum(complete.cases(locus_summary[[x]], locus_summary[[y]])),
         rho = unname(test$estimate), p = test$p.value)}, correlation_pairs$x, correlation_pairs$y)) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))

kable(correlations, digits = 3, col.names = c("x", "y", "Loci", "Spearman rho", "p", "p (Holm)"))
write_tsv(correlations, file.path(out_dir_sankey, "locus_spearman_correlations.tsv"))
write_tsv(locus_summary, file.path(out_dir_sankey, "locus_indel_homopolymer_summary.tsv"))

spearman_label <- function(x_name, y_name) { # "Spearman rho = -0.83, Holm p < 0.001, n = 33"
  result <- filter(correlations, x == x_name, y == y_name)
  stopifnot(nrow(result) == 1)
  p_text <- if (result$p_holm < 0.001) "< 0.001" else paste("=", format(signif(result$p_holm, 2)))
  sprintf("Spearman \u03c1 = %.2f, Holm p %s, n = %d", result$rho, p_text, result$n)
}

# Indel groups and plot data
indel_group_breaks <- quantile(locus_summary$indel_raw, c(1/3, 2/3)) 
indel_group_names <- c("Low indel rate", "Medium indel rate", "High indel rate") # top to bottom
indel_group_colours <- setNames(c("#E1C473", "#C3722A", "#834D24"), indel_group_names)
homopolymer_legend <- "Homopolymer \u22655 nt in primer" # diamond show homopolymers
locus_label_colour <- "grey10" 
banner_fill <- "grey88" 
banner_text_colour <- "grey15" 
legend_gap <- unit(14, "pt") # one gap for every legend entry
row_padding <- expansion(add = 0.5) 
short_locus_name <- function(locus) sub("_rs\\d+$", "", locus) # shortens TIGRP2P116705_rs8955982 to TIGRP2P116705, spacing issues

# one row per locus, indel group, diamond, row label in order and the bar-text shares
locus_info <- final_reads %>%
  summarise(bar_used = mean(short == sankey_used_label), bar_poor = mean(short == label_poor_alignment), .by = locus) %>% # % written on the bars
  left_join(locus_summary, by = "locus") %>%
  mutate(indel_group = cut(indel_raw, c(-Inf, indel_group_breaks, Inf), labels = indel_group_names),
         has_homopolymer = hp_len_primer >= 5,
         point_shape = ifelse(has_homopolymer, 18, 16), # diamond or circle
         label = formatC(short_locus_name(locus), width = max(nchar(short_locus_name(locus))), flag = "-"))

locus_info$label <- factor(locus_info$label, levels = arrange(locus_info, bar_used, locus)$label) # rows sorted by share used, lowest at the bottom

indel_group_headers <- final_reads %>% # banner text per group (read-weighted % used)
  left_join(select(locus_info, locus, indel_group), by = "locus") %>%
  summarise(used = mean(!is.na(called_allele)), .by = indel_group) %>%
  left_join(summarise(locus_info, lowest = min(indel_raw), highest = max(indel_raw), .by = indel_group), by = "indel_group") %>%
  arrange(indel_group) %>%
  mutate(header = sprintf("%s\n%.2f\u2013%.2f indels/read \u00b7 %s used", indel_group, lowest, highest, percent(used, accuracy = 1)))
kable(select(indel_group_headers, -header), digits = 3)

# share of each bar category per locus, with the locus's row label and group
locus_bars <- final_reads %>%
  count(locus, short) %>%
  complete(locus, short = bar_order, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), .by = locus) %>%
  left_join(select(locus_info, locus, label, indel_group), by = "locus") %>%
  mutate(short = factor(short, levels = rev(bar_order))) # rev: Used left, Poor right

indel_group_facets <- facet_grid(indel_group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
facet_theme <- theme(strip.text = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
                          panel.spacing.y = unit(8, "pt"))

## Panels
# group banner text, placed at the middle locus of each group
banner_labels <- locus_info %>%
  arrange(bar_used, locus) %>%
  slice(ceiling(n() / 2), .by = indel_group) %>%
  left_join(select(indel_group_headers, indel_group, header), by = "indel_group")

p_banner <- ggplot(locus_info, aes(x = 1, y = label)) +
  geom_tile(fill = banner_fill, width = 1, height = 1) +
  geom_text(data = banner_labels, aes(label = header),
            angle = 90, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95, colour = banner_text_colour) +
  indel_group_facets +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = row_padding) +
  theme_void(base_family = plot_font) +
  facet_theme

# Plot A: read outcome bars
p_bars <- ggplot(locus_bars, aes(x = share, y = label, fill = short)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(data = locus_info, aes(x = 0.012, y = label, label = percent(bar_used, accuracy = 1)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, colour = "white", size = 2.7, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = filter(locus_info, bar_poor >= 0.035), aes(x = 0.988, y = label, label = percent(bar_poor, accuracy = 1)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, colour = "white", size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(data = filter(locus_info, has_homopolymer), aes(x = -0.012, y = label, shape = homopolymer_legend), 
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4, colour = locus_label_colour) + 
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
  indel_group_facets +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = row_padding) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bar_colours, breaks = bar_order, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(18, homopolymer_legend), name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1),
         shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3, colour = locus_label_colour))) +
  labs(title = "A  Read fate per locus, grouped by indel rate", x = "Share of reads", y = NULL) +
  sankey_theme +
  facet_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold", size = 7.5, colour = locus_label_colour, margin = margin(r = 12)),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0),
        plot.title.position = "plot") 

# indels per read (part of A): dashed group boundaries and grid lines drawn per group
indel_group_boundaries <- tibble(indel_group = factor(indel_group_names[c(1, 2, 2, 3)], levels = indel_group_names),
                                      x = unname(indel_group_breaks[c(1, 1, 2, 2)])) # low: upper bound, medium: both, high: lower bound
indel_grid_lines <- tibble(indel_group = factor(c(indel_group_names, indel_group_names[3]), levels = indel_group_names),
                                x = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3)) 
indel_axis_max <- ceiling(max(locus_info$indel_raw) * 10) / 10 

p_indels <- ggplot(locus_info, aes(x = indel_raw, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(data = indel_grid_lines, aes(xintercept = x), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = indel_group_boundaries, aes(xintercept = x), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = indel_raw, yend = label), colour = "grey82", linewidth = 0.5) +
geom_point(aes(colour = indel_group, shape = point_shape, size = ifelse(has_homopolymer, 3.0, 2.2))) +
  indel_group_facets +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = row_padding) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = indel_group_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_identity() +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, indel_axis_max), breaks = seq(0.1, indel_axis_max, 0.1), 
                     labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  labs(x = "Indels per read", y = NULL) +
  sankey_theme +
  facet_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # replaced by the per-group grid lines
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())

# Plots B-D: statistics, same colours and shapes as the indel dots
stats_theme <- sankey_theme +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6))
stats_point_layers <- list(scale_colour_manual(values = indel_group_colours, guide = "none"),
                                scale_shape_identity(), scale_size_identity(), stats_theme)

p_stats_used <- ggplot(locus_info, aes(indel_raw, used)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = indel_group, shape = point_shape, size = ifelse(has_homopolymer, 2.8, 2.0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(title = "B  Indels vs reads used", subtitle = spearman_label("indel_raw", "used"),
       x = "Indels per read", y = "Reads used") +
  stats_point_layers

p_stats_length <- ggplot(locus_info, aes(primer_len, indel_raw)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = indel_group, shape = point_shape, size = ifelse(has_homopolymer, 2.8, 2.0))) +
  labs(title = "C  Primer length vs indels", subtitle = spearman_label("primer_len", "indel_raw"),
       x = "Scored primer length (nt)", y = "Indels per read") +
  stats_point_layers

p_stats_tie <- ggplot(locus_info, aes(hp_len_3p, tie)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = indel_group, shape = point_shape, size = ifelse(has_homopolymer, 2.8, 2.0)),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = filter(locus_info, tie > 0.2), aes(label = short_locus_name(locus)),
            size = 2.2, hjust = 1, nudge_x = -0.25, colour = "grey30", family = "mono") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, max(locus_info$hp_len_3p))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(title = "D  Homopolymer at SNP vs ties", subtitle = spearman_label("hp_len_3p", "tie"),
       x = "Homopolymer at SNP (nt)", y = "No allele signal") +
  stats_point_layers

p_locus_indel <- wrap_plots(# p_banner, # grey group banners left out
                                            p_bars, p_indels,
                                            wrap_plots(p_stats_used, p_stats_length, p_stats_tie, ncol = 1),
                                            nrow = 1, widths = c(8, 1.4, 3.6), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.spacing.x = legend_gap, 
        legend.key.spacing.x = legend_gap) 

print(p_locus_indel)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_by_locus_indel_groups.png"), p_locus_indel, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_by_locus_indel_groups.pdf"), p_locus_indel, width = 11.69, height = 8.27, device = cairo_pdf)
```


```{r Problem_Combinations_UpSet, eval = params$run_filtration_vis, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5.5, out.width = "85%"}
### 3. Plot UpSet shows which porblems appear together
rejected_flags <- final_reads %>%
  filter(step1 == label_primer_match, fate != sankey_used_label) %>% # matched reads rejected in step 2
  select(all_of(names(flag_labels))) %>%
  rename_with(~ flag_labels[.x])
problem_totals <- sort(colSums(rejected_flags), decreasing = TRUE)
problems <- names(problem_totals)[problem_totals > 0] # problems that never occur are left out

# true or false one row per exact combination of problems, most frequent first
problem_combinations <- rejected_flags %>%
  count(across(all_of(problems)), sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(combination = apply(pick(all_of(problems)), 1, function(row) paste(problems[row], collapse = " + ")), # bar name, e.g. "A + B"
         n_problems = rowSums(pick(all_of(problems))),
         fill_colour = ifelse(n_problems == 1, outcome_colours[combination], outcome_colours[[label_several]]),
         combination = factor(combination, levels = combination))
stopifnot(sum(problem_combinations$n) == nrow(rejected_flags), !anyNA(problem_combinations$fill_colour))

# row labels with the total per problem
problem_labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (%s)", problems, comma(problem_totals[problems])), problems)

# dot matrix: which problems each combination contains based on true or false columns
problem_matrix <- problem_combinations %>%
  select(combination, all_of(problems)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-combination, names_to = "problem", values_to = "member") %>%
  mutate(problem = factor(problem, levels = rev(problems)))

p_upset_bars <- ggplot(problem_combinations, aes(x = combination, y = n, fill = fill_colour)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)), vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Rejected reads") +
  sankey_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

p_upset_matrix <- ggplot(problem_matrix, aes(x = combination, y = problem)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(problem_matrix, member), aes(group = combination), linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#4A3B2C") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = member), size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#4A3B2C", `FALSE` = "#E6DAB9"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = problem_labels) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  sankey_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

p_upset <- wrap_plots(p_upset_bars, p_upset_matrix, ncol = 1, heights = c(3, 1.2)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Which SNP-check problems occur together in rejected reads",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5)))

print(p_upset)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_problems_upset.png"), p_upset, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_sankey, "read_problems_upset.pdf"), p_upset, width = 10, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
```
